metas.name: Still Here, Still There
metas.description: A Chinese woman in her fifties moves alone to the U.S., chasing an American Dream postponed for three decades. As she struggles between freedom and obligation, her pursuit reveals the quiet contradictions of migration—where sacrifice and obsession blur, and one woman’s journey reshapes the filmmaker’s own.

metas.name: Rage Against the Archive
metas.description: This experimental browser-based film investigates the networked afterlives of ethnographic photographs from the 19th-century colonial publication 'The People of India' as they circulate through the New York Public Library’s digital archive. Through performative interventions and acts of Electronic Civil Disobedience that corrupt the archive’s HTML code, the artist transforms the website itself into a site of protest.

metas.name: I Wanna Be With You Everywhere
metas.description: Recognizing that, due to a lack of access, disability communities are often barred from cultural institutions and social resources, an artist collective produces uniquely accessible events for an ever-expanding vision of a cross-disability community. Capturing them at work and at play, this film embraces the collective’s commitment to an aesthetics that incorporates collectively made creative access while highlighting integrated audio description, open captioning, descriptive audio narration, and ASL interpretation integrated into the film itself.

metas.name: The Order
metas.description: A phantasmagorical audio-visual overload of vampiric Philaspychogeography and pure psychic energy made manifest via filmmaker Nathaniel C. Shannon (Saint Vitus Bar: The First Ten Years Book, Deadguy: Killing Music), with score and sound-design by Don Devore, founding member of legendary Philadelphia hardcore band Ink & Dagger.

metas.name: I'm Not You
metas.description: Eighteen-year-old Joe is caught in an emotional storm of identity, sexuality, and expectation. This crisis rips the heart out of a world that once seemed simply, now torn between the pressures imposed by a traditional working-class family and labels imposed by friendships groups and individuals. Joe embarks on a journey of discovery and introspection that threatens to destroy a family, a community, and ultimately a life.

metas.name: Power Trip
metas.description: A rideshare driver ends up in an unexpectedly complicated conversation with a passenger.

metas.name: Tuna on Rye
metas.description: Amy and Arthur deal with the everyday complications of Arthur’s dementia.

metas.name: Camp Rock 3
metas.description: When Connect 3 loses their opening act for a major reunion tour, they return to their beloved Camp Rock to discover the next big thing. As campers vie for the chance to open for their favorite band, tensions rise and friendships are tested - leading to unexpected alliances, revelations, and romances.

metas.name: Travis Barker: Louder Than Fear
metas.description: After surviving a devastating plane crash that nearly took his life, legendary and electrifying drummer Travis Barker embarks on a raw and redemptive journey in this intimate portrait of the man behind the tattoos who transformed pain into power.

metas.name: How the Sausage Was Made
metas.description: A making-of doc for “Fuck My Son.”

metas.name: Ballad of Eighteen
metas.description: A father's gift to his daughter on her 18th birthday - a diary. The diary remained untouched, until the daughter inscribed his eulogy on its first page. Through the mist of Chinese ritual, each image of memory lingers like the final note of a melancholy song.

metas.name: Independence
metas.description: As the UK overhauls its benefits system, three disabled people navigate a hostile bureaucracy that demands constant proof of disability in order to access support. Through re-edited interviews and speculative imagery, the film reveals how enforced visibility restricts care. As an alternative, the film imagines aesthetic interdependence as a radical form of resistance.

metas.name: DUST DREAM
metas.description: Four middle-aged women each confront their deepest fears in their dreams—things they never wish to happen, yet feel as if they have already lived through. In the end, dreams and reality blur into one indistinguishable chaos.

metas.name: documentary
metas.description: This short film uses a destructive, frame-by-frame editing pipeline to glitch and reshape a spoken testimony into a reflection of the filmmaker's own anxieties. Through generative fill, frame-interpolation, and manipulative editing, the narrative is humorously transformed into a disturbing commentary on the pastimes of the elite.

metas.name: as the fires rage on
metas.description: In a world of escalating wildfires and expanding prison systems, an incarcerated crew fights fires for 70¢ an hour. As the camera observes their daily routines, it examines not just their labor, but the systems of surveillance shaping both their lives and the film’s production.

metas.name: Bajo el Sol
metas.description: During a summer spent with his grandmother on the Oaxacan Coast, a filmmaker explores the layered relationship Puerto Escondido has with tourism through conversations around labor, water, contamination, and gentrification with tourists and locals alike.

metas.name: The Suburban Swindle
metas.description: Throughout the midwest one criminal syndicate is feared above all else, the Suburban Swindlers. Yet again they have gotten away… or so they think? Can they get away with their greatest deception yet as the law closes in, or will they end up caught in their web of lies.

metas.name: Girls Weekend
metas.description: plot unknown

metas.name: Bonne Omelette
metas.description: An aspiring home cook strives to craft the perfect omelette for his partner in this passionate food film.

metas.name: Primary
metas.description: Three colourful characters navigate insecurity, virility, and death over a single day.

metas.name: KATSEYE: WILD HEARTS
metas.description: A captivating journey into KATSEYE's bold new era while celebrating the fans who helped make it possible. Featuring never-before-seen footage, EYEKONS fan videos, and intimate interviews from the group members, explore the powerful bond between KATSEYE and their global fandom. A love letter to the EYEKONS who helped build this movement, see why this group's story is only just beginning.

metas.name: Fast
metas.description: For Sterling, a sort of present-day Alice, the graveyard Lotus she redeems becomes a totem, a saturated phenomenon permitting her to move freely in time on a phantom road. It is a sort of Ford but never a DeLorean. A Southern woman with a fair deal of historical baggage and deep secrets, Sterling journeys back to her rural home, the Lotus takes her through the shadow of the valley into the adjoining worlds of the living and the dead. Desiring to become an F1 driver, Sterling must go fast/hard, against/through all tunnels imagined or concrete.

metas.name: Every Now and Then, I Fall Apart
metas.description: Haunted by her best friend’s overdose, Eden numbs her grief through fleeting intimacy and quiet self-destruction. A sudden call from God pulls her back to the site of the death, where she’s offered a choice that forces her to confront what she’s been avoiding—and what she’s willing to destroy.

metas.name: Shackled
metas.description: In a dystopian future where the parole system has been replaced with R.A.P.P. - the Recidivism Accountability Partnership Program - a white collar ex-con must take drastic measures to ensure his survival when he's paired with a sociopathic gangster with terminal cancer. One wrong move by either of them could mean the summary execution of them both, via the explosive charges surgically implanted in their hearts as a condition of their release.

metas.name: Eye to Eye
metas.description: A young man helps his girlfriend to see without sight.

metas.name: Like a Mammoth to a Giant Flame
metas.description: LIke a Mammoth to a Giant Flame is a 45 minute documentary/concert film about the Montreal band Mellow Casualty.

metas.name: Cheesecake
metas.description: A husband sets out to buy cheesecake for his pregnant wife, only to be swallowed by city chaos as she goes into labor alone.

metas.name: Peter
metas.description: Young Canadian Alden Brown traveled from Nova Scotia to Hollywood in the early 1980s and became one of the biggest porn stars ever.

metas.name: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
metas.description: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

metas.name: The Cuts
metas.description: Theatre faculty spar over outlandish financial schemes to keep their department afloat. The arts are worth saving - but can these bozos do it?

metas.name: Meet Cute In the CCU
metas.description: In the waiting room of a hospital's Cardiac Care Unit, two strangers, Sophia and Emilio, await word about their respective loved ones in surgery. Seeing Sophia is near panic, Emilio starts a conversation about topics innocuous (incompetent winking, the meaning of corniness) and profound (life's journey). In the process they make a connection that will forever alter the course of both of their lives.

metas.name: Under One Roof
metas.description: Dani, a product of divorce and a single mother, is working from home while caring for her peppery, sick mother when her bohemian father shows up on her doorstep, homeless. What follows is a cramped, chaotic reunion about family, friction, and being stuck together.

metas.name: Have A Heart
metas.description: Diana has a vendetta against dating. When led to a surprise blind date by her boy-mad best friend, Solana,  she gets blindsided by an accidental love arrow—courtesy of a burned-out Cupid and a date with an agenda.

metas.name: The Odyssey
metas.description: Telemachus is in search for his father, Odysseus, who disappeared 20 years ago.

metas.name: Down But Not Out
metas.description: Kid gets bullied and challenges bully to a boxing match

metas.name: Dementium
metas.description: Wyatt Bailey settles into a secluded and unknown to him cabin on a small Christmas tree farm with one driving goal; to solve his mother's murder. Unfortunately, the one person who might hold the answer is dead and wrapped in plastic in the back of his trunk... It's Wyatt's father. In a final and desperate attempt, Wyatt takes DMT, determined to ask his father the truth -- If he killed his own wife. What follows is both horror and hope in the cosmic arrival of Wyatt's charming ex-girlfriend, Cora, who continually begs him to revisit their first date together, as well as a haunting and terrifying witch hell-bent on Wyatt hurting himself. As Wyatt's drug-fueled nightmare unfolds, both entities will fight for Wyatt's soul as he works on coming to terms with his own complicated past.

metas.name: Lost Weekend Planetarium Experience
metas.description: Experience Lost Weekend in a breathtaking audiovisual journey that travels from the star-filled skies of Madagascar and the shimmering Northern Lights above Iceland's glaciers to the powerful storms across Texas. Filmed in nearly 20 countries, with no computer-generated imagery, this show brings audiences closer to the natural world through stunning nightscapes that blend music, science, art, and a sense of discovery.

metas.name: Rebel Flowers
metas.description: A nun is forced to confront her own past and make a decision destined to change the course of her life forever. When her best friend asks her help, faith, guilt, and friendship collide.

metas.name: Live Crickets
metas.description: Cass throws an impromptu funeral for her oldest friend, two weeks after her boyfriend dumped her and moved out. As Cass walks through the sea of people she thought might be her friends, we watch her realize just how alone she truly is.

metas.name: Three Days in Summer
metas.description: During a nature retreat class, two incompatible students and their oddball instructor are forced to get along after everyone else drops the course.

metas.name: Inheritance
metas.description: After their father's cremation, three estranged siblings return home hoping to find closure, but buried tensions resurface when their mother reveals an unexpected decision about the family home forcing them to confront their fractured relationships and shared grief.

metas.name: All The Time
metas.description: Rose and Cole, two former lovers, reunite unexpectedly at a New Year’s house party and must confront their unresolved regrets as nostalgia resurfaces.

metas.name: Dance with Me
metas.description: As the boundaries between past and present blur, Anya  fights to hold onto Sasha, an elderly Holocaust survivor with dementia, as he struggles to distinguish memory from reality.

metas.name: My First Kiss
metas.description: Hally looks back on the night of her first kiss.

metas.name: Dance With Me
metas.description: As the boundaries between past and present blur, an elderly Holocaust survivor with dementia struggles to distinguish memory from reality while his devoted wife fights to hold onto the man she loves before he slips away forever.

metas.name: Mesmera
metas.description: When a series of gruesome suicides plagues a small Northern California town, Detective Hill investigates a mysterious lead, resulting in a deadly encounter with an occult mesmerist responsible for the deaths.

metas.name: Things Always Look Brighter in the Morning
metas.description: Two stranger meet and have a suspicion that they're similarities aren't coincidental...

metas.name: Dinner Tine
metas.description: An employee just wants all of her coworkers to be friends, but unfortunately they all hate each other. The only way for them to become friends is to... throw a dinner party.

metas.name: Miso Soup
metas.description: College student Reiko enrolls in a Japanese-language class to learn her heritage language. However, she begins to fall behind and feels like she is not Japanese enough. In turn, Reiko has to navigate her own feelings about having a dual identity.

metas.name: Three Housewives and a Body
metas.description: Lorelai loves living in her neighborhood, right next to best friends Jackie and Ella. During girl's night at Jackie's house a home invasion goes terribly wrong when the three women accidentally kill a man.

metas.name: Elise's Dream
metas.description: Elise has a dream about a Cove—and today that dream comes true...

metas.name: A Flash and How It Lasts
metas.description: Living in Los Angeles, a young Chinese gay man longs for the connection with his estranged father that seems out of reach. One day, his father visits him from China, and he discovers the tenderness and sorrow of his father that he had never seen before.

metas.name: Words From The Void
metas.description: A young man has to grapple with an intense moral dilemma.

metas.name: My Type
metas.description: Inspired by a true story, two twenty-somethings whose shared experience with Type 1 Diabetes sparks an unexpected love connection.

metas.name: irregular
metas.description: a collection of vignettes illustrating a typical tuesday at a dive bar in New York City.

metas.name: Death Do Us Part
metas.description: In the middle ages Giulia, a young rebel, lives in a superstitious little town. She interacts with Death to fight and defeat the black plague.

metas.name: Monstrous Me
metas.description: When Ariel was a disabled and disfigured child of three years old, a bad babysitter brought over a bag of weed, her boyfriend, and a VHS of A Nightmare on Elm Street. From under the coffee table, through the railings, Ariel saw themselves in that Zenith television, in the face of Freddy Krueger, and decided there was agency in being a monster rather than a martyr.

metas.name: Umbravius
metas.description: The unknown starts happening in a room full of disbelieve, a men trying to understand the disturbing acts around him when a much darker force is crawling around him for decades..

metas.name: BUS... STOP!
metas.description: A smuggler, an FBI Agent, a journalist, and a man with a talking sombrero happen to all meet at a bus stop.

metas.name: Catching Light
metas.description: Two women in a working relationship. One is more invested than the other, to the point that it breaks her.

metas.name: In the Moment
metas.description: A group of childhood friends reunites during their winter break from college.

metas.name: Degree of Certainty
metas.description: When a young risk analyst at a major US oil company in 1982 learns that the climate research department has just discovered a rapid rise in global temperatures, he has to decide on which side of history he wants to be.

metas.name: St. Jones Ditch
metas.description: A college professor, Tim Donnelly, is caught in an affair with his daughter's roommate. He loses his job, his wife kicks him out, and he hits the road in despair. He finds himself in St. Jones' Ditch, a ghost town in deep East Texas that hasn't quite died, though the folks who end up there have a habit of doing just that. This is a place where people go to quit living. Tim takes his place amongst the odd denizens of the bar and the equally quirky residents, and decides whether or not his life is worth living. This is a dramedy with some naughty laughs and an ultimately redemptive arc.

metas.name: Slogans (Part One)
metas.description: "The Interview"

metas.name: Her Trepidation
metas.description: Pahinag falls lucid in her dream re-living her traumatic past. She wants to change what was done on her but has to avoid the hazards that come along the way.

metas.name: The Spider and the Bee
metas.description: A potential one night stand takes a turn.

metas.name: She Stole My Son's Heart
metas.description: After her last heart transplant fails, Maria is in desperate need of a new heart. Fearing it could give out at any moment, she turns down her boyfriend’s proposal and heads out for a walk — only to mysteriously disappear. As the search intensifies, homicide and missing persons detective Vicky and her rookie partner are assigned to the case. With Maria's time running out, it becomes a race to uncover the truth behind Maria's disappearance before her failing heart gives out.

metas.name: Today, Tomorrow, Yesterday
metas.description: While caring for her terminally ill mother, a young artist battling depression believes acceptance into her dream school will finally give her life meaning, only to discover that the person she needed to believe in her was herself.

metas.name: Coming Down The Road: The Summer Blockbuster Tour
metas.description: A documentation of Cleveland artists Puma Thurman, DoHM, Meladite, and Irewyrm as they go on their first ever tour across the United States.

metas.name: Absolutely Devoted to You
metas.description: An ambitious TV producer devises a brilliant plan to reunite a 90's boy band for an annual summer beach bash, but her idea is derailed when she falls for the band's reluctant lead singer.

metas.name: Sawdust
metas.description: To afford an attorney for their immigrant father in detention, a former construction worker must perform as a femme fatale and seduce a wealthy client.

metas.name: The Assassin
metas.description: A man guided by his job begins to question his world.

metas.name: Barm IV: Tracks of Blood
metas.description: Recently widowed barm goes on a wild train ride full of suspense and intrigue.

metas.name: Awake
metas.description: A corrupt police officer investigates his best friend's murder, getting involved in an underground drug ring in Southern Rhode Island.

metas.name: Stonewalling
metas.description: After experiencing the classic meet-cute, Dean discovers an unexplainable force that keeps him from making contact with Anika. As each creative attempt to bypass the barrier takes a physically depleting toll on him, Dean must realize the unchangeable nature of their fate.

metas.name: Letter to Sirius
metas.description: A film by Kelley Dong.

metas.name: PERFECTIONIST
metas.description: A creative artist falls into obsession and overwhelming determination for an art final as she simultaneously looks back on another artistic sibling of hers.

metas.name: Osees Live in Los Angeles
metas.description: We had agreed to do a 6 show residency at the Teragram in Los Angeles in 2025. Tried to mix it up for the kiddos so I brought on the big guns…BRIGID DAWSON. And boom goes the dynamite! The missing key component to all of this middle era Garage Punk junk. Culled from the last 3 shows here are the creme de la creme of the tunes. Some long bloated fliers and some short sweet friers.

metas.name: Bottled Up
metas.description: Simon decides to declare his love to his boss, Melanie, by hosting a romantic dinner at his mom's house. Over the course of the night, a number of unexpected guests show up leading to an onslaught of confusion.

metas.name: Peregrine Falcon
metas.description: Two young female serial killers take refuge in an abandoned warehouse to plot their next move. As one of the girls struggles with her role as the de facto leader, the other strives to prove her devotion as a follower.

metas.name: The Corner
metas.description: Follows youth boxing coach Daysi Garcia as she fights to give her kids a path to a better future.

metas.name: Baltimore Heirs: The Last Deed Undone
metas.description: This powerful documentary examines the hidden crisis of heirs' property and the lasting impact of systemic displacement on Black families in Baltimore. Through deeply personal stories and historical analysis, the film explores how tangled titles, predatory property systems, tax sales, and generations of inequitable housing policies have contributed to the loss of family homes, land, and wealth in historically Black communities.

metas.name: In the Kitchen
metas.description: In an Upper Manhattan townhouse, a Man and Woman work to get dinner on the table as a playdate downstairs threatens to go horribly wrong.

metas.name: A Good Man 3
metas.description: Ethan uses a secret dating app for married people looking for affairs. A new romantic link makes him doubt his choices while the police close in on him.

metas.name: The Final Fork
metas.description: When her beloved fifth fork mysteriously disappears, an obsessive woman embarks on an increasingly absurd journey to find it, slowly rediscovering the world she’s been too distracted to notice.

metas.name: The Secret Lives of Suburban Housewives
metas.description: When one couple moves to suburbia, they realize their neighbors are hiding more than a few scandals. After a shocking death rattles the neighborhood, lies and revelations come to surface as a killer races against time to keep their secret buried for good.

metas.name: The Day You Begin
metas.description: On their first day of school, four imaginative kids feel like they don’t belong, until they learn that everyone has a unique story to share. The Day You Begin is a journey of self-acceptance, courage, and the magic that comes when we connect with others. Bursting with color, laughs, and compassion, this animated adaptation brings Jacqueline Woodson’s beloved book to life, reminding kids that every voice matters and every difference is a strength.

metas.name: You Want a Mint?
metas.description: In a city where the rich start to die with their mouths mysteriously filled with mints, Don- a celebrated detective- follows the mints to their source, unaware that his curiosity and class has already made him part of the killer’s target.

metas.name: Behind the Eight-Ball
metas.description: A high-functioning cocaine addict's life begins to crumble as his drug use intensifies, pushing him to face his inner battles and seek redemption before losing everything he values.

metas.name: Two Spirit Initiative
metas.description: A short documentary about the Gender and Sexuality Alliance Network's TSI Initiative.

metas.name: The Ideal
metas.description: With one last chance to speak to his dead younger sister, Felix struggles to find the “right way” to come out to her as a transgender man.

metas.name: Tú y Yo
metas.description: When Estella’s only daughter announces she’s moving away, this codependent mother is forced to confront a life of her own for the first time in decades. Stuck in the same routines and surrounded by nosy neighbors in her desert mobile home community, Estella takes an unexpected leap into the dating world—and into self-discovery.

metas.name: Fortune House
metas.description: A desperate immigrant delivery driver stumbles into a mahjong parlor run by three demons, where he enters a demon’s deal: win the game, and they will grant him a green card.

metas.name: Alterity
metas.description: A group of paranormal researchers discover a dormant alien invasion force hidden in an abandoned shopping mall slated for demolition.

metas.name: Lajiao's Holes
metas.description: Lajiao wants to do things her own way, but a little girl will remind her of her mission as a member of the Zodiac.

metas.name: Glimmer
metas.description: After losing a career-defining fashion opportunity, aspiring queer Latinx designer Carlos begins questioning both his talent and his future. Encouraged by his outspoken best friend and inspired by unexpected moments of connection, he discovers the power of ‘glimmers’—small, magical moments of hope that illuminate life’s path. Set against the vibrant backdrop of queer nightlife, fashion, and chosen family, Glimmer is a heartfelt story about resilience, self-worth, and believing in yourself when everything feels uncertain.

metas.name: i wonder shall i fly
metas.description: Formerly enslaved people reflect Black history through 1940s interview audio and timeless home movies.

metas.name: Genevieve's Garden
metas.description: After being dumped and laid off in quick succession, Lily finds herself at a rising influencer’s new wellness retreat in the Hudson Valley. Looking for a distraction, she becomes obsessively infatuated with a fellow guest.

metas.name: Gun Pilots
metas.description: Gun Pilots takes a compelling insider’s view into the rigorous world of U.S. Army Apache flight training. It follows student aviators as they confront the formidable challenge of mastering the AH-64 Apache—the most lethal attack helicopter ever built!

metas.name: Call of My Life
metas.description: The romantic comedy follows Soluchi, a hopeless romantic still healing from being jilted by her former lover, Kalu. When a regular work call puts her in touch with the charming Eli, Soluchi begins to see the possibility of the love story she has always wanted.

metas.name: Rosebush Pruning
metas.description: In a Spanish villa, American siblings Jack, Ed, Anna and Robert wallow in isolation and their inherited fortune. When Jack wants to move in with his girlfriend and Ed uncovers the truth about their mother’s death, the fabric of the family begins to unravel.

metas.name: The Mandalorian and Grogu
metas.description: The evil Empire has fallen, and Imperial warlords remain scattered throughout the galaxy. As the fledgling New Republic works to protect everything the Rebellion fought for, they have enlisted the help of legendary Mandalorian bounty hunter Din Djarin and his young apprentice Grogu.

metas.name: Splash City
metas.description: Two brothers on diverging paths struggle to survive amidst the pressures of their community.

metas.name: Charli's on the Run
metas.description: Charli, a runaway from a highly limiting family, must discover her true identity after meeting Emma, a dancer.

metas.name: Heartstopper Forever
metas.description: It's a new school year for the Truham-Higgs gang. As Nick and Charlie's relationship deepens, their thoughts turn to life after the last bell rings.

metas.name: Chunks
metas.description: An anthology film of six unique comedy shorts threaded together with your host, faded Hollywood starlet Ruby, and taking inspiration from the glamourous by-gone era of late nite public access weirdness.  With live action shorts featuring originals from Podcast About List, Sandy Honig, Nate Fisher & Will Senett, and two animated segments from Episode 1 & Jim Soper, and Nick Mullen & Saul Crinier.

metas.name: In the Company of Wolves: An American Journey
metas.description: Follows the journey of wolves and other animals as co-travelers through American history.

metas.name: Finding Orson
metas.description: Andrew Callaghan helps find a lost parrot

metas.name: Angel (ii.4) PROCESS REMINISCENCE
metas.description: ANGEL PROJECTed. Companion film to ANGEL (iii).

metas.name: Obsession Unleashed
metas.description: Go behind the scenes with in-depth interviews featuring Curry Barker and the cast

metas.name: That Ain’t Him
metas.description: When a young man and is buddy try to set up a spooky prank for a friend, he soon realizes his buddy may not actually be whom he thinks he is after all.

metas.name: People Magazine Investigates: The Cosmic Intelligence Cult
metas.description: A deep dive into the cult and its prophet, Rashad Jamal, who established the cult during the Covid-19 pandemic

metas.name: Rooks For Crooks
metas.description: Four crooks aim to score big time with a home invasion, but complications soon set in.

metas.name: The Real Wolf of Wall Street
metas.description: This three-part documentary reveals the explosive true story that inspired The Wolf of Wall Street.

metas.name: When did we start using passports?
metas.description: As the world becomes increasingly global for some, and increasingly divided for others, the question remains: Should lines on a map be what determine a person's rights and freedoms?

metas.name: REALITY
metas.description: Sam struggles trying to distinguish reality and his hallucinations

metas.name: Boring Guys
metas.description: Gary and Garry live a tedious life of TV and rigatoni. Until jealousy strikes...

metas.name: The Light of Bulgaria
metas.description: Filmed during Great Lent, Great and Holy Week, and the joyous celebration of Pascha in 2025, “The Light of Bulgaria” combines historical research, firsthand interviews, and footage from across Bulgaria to tell a story largely unknown outside that country.  Although the Old Calendar Orthodox Church of Bulgaria finally obtained legal registration after many years of efforts, recent legislative changes supported by the Patriarchate of Bulgaria have once again placed its future in jeopardy. As renewed legal efforts seek to dissolve the Church, this documentary offers an opportunity to understand both the history that led to this moment and the Faithful who continue to endure opposition.

metas.name: The Odyssey: The Making of an Epic
metas.description: Go behind the scenes of Christopher Nolan's mythic action epic, The Odyssey. This special documentary explores the monumental undertaking of adapting Homer’s foundational saga for the big screen, charting a grueling 91-day principal photography schedule across six countries. From the revolutionary use of brand-new IMAX film technology to the massive coordination of over 5,300 custom-designed costumes, discover how a star-studded cast led by Matt Damon, Tom Holland, and Anne Hathaway brought the dangerous, timeless world of ancient Greek gods and monsters to life.

metas.name: Model Home
metas.description: A housewife in 60s America goes about her daily housework, while pining for her absent Husband.

metas.name: From Somebody That You Used To Know
metas.description: A young man has trouble finding the right greeting card for his estranged cousin.

metas.name: When the Message Ends
metas.description: While packing away pieces of his past, a young man discovers an unheard voicemail from someone he lost years ago. As the message slowly unfolds, he is forced to confront grief, and the silence left behind.

metas.name: Love on Tap
metas.description: Amber, a headstrong brewery owner, and Samuel, a slick marketing strategist, clash over how to save her failing business. But as they stir up a plan to reinvent the brewery, they unexpectedly ferment their own love story.

metas.name: The Good Boy Report
metas.description: A young girl named Bunny hosts, edits and narrates a hard-hitting journalistic exposé about all the dogs in her neighborhood.

metas.name: A Walk in the Park
metas.description: A secret agent faces unexpected obstacles during a time-sensitive mission.

metas.name: All We Do Is Watch Movies
metas.description: A documentary short about Portland’s iconic Hollywood Theatre and Movie Madness video store.

metas.name: Cause of Death
metas.description: When their target dies of natural causes just hours before they arrive, two incompetent hit-men scramble to stage a convincing murder before their employer figures out they didn't do their job.

metas.name: Underbrush
metas.description: Two young boys simulate a gun battle in a lush forest, leaving one to confront his fear of real loss.

metas.name: Battle For the Bid
metas.description: Battle For The Bid is a documentary series that chronicles the journey of the Boston University men's basketball team as they attempt to reclaim a dream interrupted by the COVID-19 pandemic. Through intimate storytelling and unprecedented access, the series explores perseverance, leadership, identity and the realities of life beyond college athletics.

metas.name: Bad Cop, Bad Cop
metas.description: Bad Cop, Bad Cop is a crime comedy short film about two big-hearted police officers, Eddie and Joel, who believe they've caught the ultimate villain...or just a guy in for a parking ticket. Through their interrogation of Hunter, a guy in for a parking ticket, can they prove to the Chief that they were meant to be police officers? Or are they onto the wrong hunch?

metas.name: Bloody Nose
metas.description: A nosebleed in the bathroom sink.

metas.name: Deadly Sign-In
metas.description: When recorded audio from a murder starts playing on the speakers from an unknown device, Kate doesn’t know if it’s real or a prank.

metas.name: Minland Empire
metas.description: Ex-cons Bob and Kevin navigate the challenges of modern life when an old nemesis unexpectedly returns and threatens their retirement.

metas.name: Autosave
metas.description: Bintang, who had lost his father, embarks on a new in-game adventure alongside his father after he gathers the courage to play it again. It’s their favourite console game that they haven’t finished yet.

metas.name: Glass Saints
metas.description: A group of young men ranging from the ages of 18 to 24 live their bizarre eccentric lives in a world that doesn't understand them. They navigate life's course one day at a time.

metas.name: Keizo Murase: The Last Monster Maker
metas.description: Artist. Innovator. Teacher. Inspiration.  From his humble beginnings as a modeling assistant in 1958 to his acclaimed directorial debut, Brush of the God in 2024, the legendary Keizo Murase spent his career dedicated to the art of monster making, bringing life to many of Japan’s most iconic and beloved kaiju characters. But behind every rampaging monster and transforming superhero were the hands of a dedicated artist, whose contributions to the Japanese film industry might have been forgotten, if not for a dedicated group of close friends, longtime admirers, and fans from every corner of the globe. For the first time in the English-speaking world, the life and career of this singular creative visionary is revealed and celebrated in a feature-length tribute that sheds detailed light on the accomplishments of Japan’s last great monster maker, and preserves the stories of those who knew and loved him best.

metas.name: The Salisbury Poisonings: A Spy Next Door
metas.description: The story begins in March 2018, when former Russian intelligence officer Sergei Skripal and his daughter Yulia collapse on a park bench in Salisbury, England – a quaint, historic city where nothing normally happens. But what starts as a local incident explodes into a geopolitical crisis, which exposes the covert espionage war being raged between Russia and the West. A cinematic portrait of loyalty and betrayal and a story that resonates amid ongoing tensions with Russia, the documentary explores the collision of two men: Sergei Skripal and Vladimir Putin, the dictator determined to settle an old score by sending assassins to Salisbury armed with the deadly nerve agent Novichok.

metas.name: Dante: 500 Miles on Psychedelics
metas.description: A man embarks on a grueling 500 mile run through the desert using psychedelics to push his physical and mental limits. While he battles his inner demons and the harsh terrain, he seeks redemption, aiming to prove that human potential is limitless and to challenge the stigma surrounding unconventional healing.

metas.name: Wedding Flowers
metas.description: A begrudgingly adept, family outcast and her overbearing mother struggle to find connection as their Vietnamese American family reunites for a wedding celebration.

metas.name: There'll Likely be Michael Jackson Vigils Throughout the Night
metas.description: Through nearly a thousand found footage videos from the early internet, filmmaker Marcus Batto recreates the day of Michael Jackson's passing, assembling a vast, fragmented portrait of the cultural earthquake. Equal parts elegy, musical, and excavation into the death of the King of Pop from the lens of strangers, critics and bystanders.

metas.name: Wildman
metas.description: An aloof young man escapes to the wilds of Yosemite in the throes of a depressive episode. His only companion is a camera.

metas.name: AM/FM
metas.description: A recluse virtual DJ and his obsessive listener are pulled together by an eerie radio signal—both yearning for a connection they can’t describe.

metas.name: O Little Christmas Market
metas.description: An artist's fights to saves her town's beloved Christmas market from a developer but a budding romance with the architect tied to the deal may help bring about a Christmas miracle.

metas.name: DETAIL THE HUMAN OPERA
metas.description: Ramiel is on the subway with his girlfriend when he sees someone from his past on an adjacent running train. He decides to get some closure.

metas.name: Forever
metas.description: A girl recounts a fleeting summer love in a poetic memory.

metas.name: Cecilia Is Only Eight Years Old
metas.description: Cecilia is about to turn 68 and has never been creative in her life. Spurred on by her curmudgeonly and competitive best friend, she enters a talent competition.

metas.name: A Dream Like a Dream
metas.description: A man finds his soul lingering in the remnants of daily life. Unaware of his own death, he feels no particular concern for his destination. An unexpected phone call forges a brief connection to the living world—a bond as fleeting as his mortal existence, where genuine engagement always eluded him.

metas.name: A Remedy for a Dying Friend
metas.description: Jo’s friend is dying, she must find a remedy to save her.

metas.name: SOCAPA THE CAMP THE FILM THE MOVIE
metas.description: Two Camp Counselors prove they can make a movie!

metas.name: Critical Path
metas.description: Critical Path offers an exclusive, behind-the-scenes look at the engineering marvel that is the SpaceX Starship program. The documentary details the iterative design philosophy, the high-stakes testing, and the relentless drive to build the largest and most powerful rocket ever flown. From the first conceptual sketches to the atmospheric re-entry and landing attempts, this film chronicles the single, complex path of innovation required to make life multi-planetary.

metas.name: NOXIOUS
metas.description: Created as his HKU graduation project, Kay Hilman’s animated short film, NOXIOUS, is a haunting exploration of a world reclaimed by nature. Created in Blender with a hand-drawn illustrative style, it imagines a impressive but terrifying new lifeform that has decided to claim our planet for itself. The music and sound design by Mikael Umarov helps set the mood.

metas.name: The One Next Door
metas.description: When a mysterious stranger moves in next door to Robert and Tabitha, boundaries are tested, loyalty is questioned, and danger comes for all.

metas.name: Dune Runner
metas.description: A guy needs trained in the art of dune running to defeat his rival, so he calls upon an ancient trainer to teach him...  but much stupider.

metas.name: The Sunken Sahara: ERI-TV
metas.description: Found on forgotten cassette tapes and long-lost duplicate VHS recordings, ERi-TV The Sunken Sahara airs once, on a late December night in 1998. An objective relic of the Eritrea-Ethiopia war, some call it a propaganda piece, some call it protest art, some say something deeper.  Allegedly "brainwashed" witnesses described what they saw as "magic".  The original writers and those associated with the broadcast are unknown and their words are misremembered and misheard.

metas.name: All For You
metas.description: A short film inspired by the albums Preacher’s Daughter and Willoughby Tucker, I’ll Always Love You by Ethel Cain.

metas.name: Help Wanted!
metas.description: An unclear job listing and loads of miscommunication make for a comedic interview between these three characters.

metas.name: Dread
metas.description: Terror takes many forms. In five chilling tales, the mundane becomes monstrous and no one gets out clean.

metas.name: The Night Everything Changed
metas.description: When Tina's teenage daughter doesn't return home from a sleepover with her closest friends, she goes on a frantic hunt to find her before it's too late. In the process, she unravels dark secrets of a forbidden romance and a tryst among BFFs.

metas.name: Jonás
metas.description: Jonás, a teenager about to become a father, has secretly decided to escape.

metas.name: Intrusive Thought
metas.description: two friends are walking when they see a button and argue if they should press it

metas.name: Utopia Air
metas.description: Welcome aboard Utopia Air! Please pay close attention to the following safety instructions.

metas.name: Storm
metas.description: A drifting beach ball must avoid an incoming storm.

metas.name: Flowery Voices
metas.description: After a fight, a young man calls up a friend.

metas.name: Shipwrecked: Nightmare at Sea
metas.description: Never-before-seen footage and survivor accounts trace the 2012 shipwreck of a luxury cruise and the disaster that ensued, in this immersive documentary.

metas.name: Still Water
metas.description: In 2008, as China basks in Olympic glory, Xi, a domestic worker, remains haunted by the loss of her sister in a devastating earthquake. When she learns of her sister’s reincarnation, she becomes drawn to her employer’s unborn child, convinced it is her sister.

metas.name: No Sun on Salvation
metas.description: In 1897, Penelope comes to terms with the death of her father with the help of Alabama, a hermit whose daughter is dying from the same illness.

metas.name: Rabbit on a Highway
metas.description: A neurotic, alcoholic trans man struggles through navigating his social and love life.

metas.name: If You Can Make It Here
metas.description: Kingsley, Kevin, and Hailey are three ambitious eighth graders preparing for a single exam that could determine their futures. They’re competing for admission to New York City’s Specialized High Schools, elite public institutions that have produced Nobel Prize laureates, astronauts, judges, artists, and national leaders. But as the kids await their test results, a citywide battle is raging over who should attend these schools—the kids who score highest on the entrance exam or the kids who improve diversity. Featuring interviews with kids, parents, and education leaders, If You Can Make It Here places young students at the center of a high-stakes cultural conflict over the future of equity and excellence in public education.

metas.name: All the Queens Houses
metas.description: A photographic exploration of Queens’ unconventional architecture reveals the borough’s beauty through the eyes of an architect while uncovering the deeper history behind its strange and spectacular designs.

metas.name: Laundry day lovers
metas.description: In conversation over dirty clothes, Paul and Ed air out their true feelings for one another.

metas.name: The Isolate Thief
metas.description: A young woman struggles to conceal the gold she stole from a group of violent outlaws who have seized control of her remote outpost.

metas.name: Down the Long River
metas.description: In the aftermath of the Civil War, a former Army surgeon, a notorious gang, and a duplicitous Pinkerton agent cross paths in a tiny river town. When revenge and a fortune in gold are at stake, the town is caught in the crossfire.

metas.name: The Outer Threat
metas.description: After making a groundbreaking extraterrestrial discovery, astrophysicists Daniel and Michelle are forced to flee from home with their family — pursued through the countryside by a relentless and anonymous assailant. As their flight unfolds, the line between cosmic revelation and human paranoia blurs, leading to a tense and emotional confrontation that challenges the boundaries of understanding, science, and survival.

metas.name: The Misadventures of Girth Brooks
metas.description: Prequel short film to “BUM” (2025)

metas.name: Code for the People
metas.description: Short documentary by the makers of WordPress about the fight for the open web. Who built it, who’s trying to close it, and what you can do about it.

metas.name: Museum Misfits
metas.description: When two thieves attempt to steal a prized museum painting, their original escape attempt is ruined through a planning mistake. Now they must try to find a new exit before they get caught.

metas.name: IBS
metas.description: Andie experiences chronic digestive issues but hides it from her roommate. When she is prescribed a stool sample kit for the first time, she has to learn to take care of her health and deal with her own shit (literally and figuratively).

metas.name: Bobby Josh: Shadow Of Darkness
metas.description: When a string of mysterious disappearances shakes the city, seven friends uncover a terrifying truth—the mastermind behind the chaos is Bobby Josh, a brilliant but ruthless figure who thrives in the shadows. As Tanner Pridemore, Ian B, Lucas Galloway, Ian Stevenson, Garylee Michael Smith III, Brandon Lopez, and Gavin Latourette race to stop his deadly plan, every clue pulls them deeper into a web of deception, betrayal, and fear. With time running out and darkness closing in, they'll have to risk everything to face the man who always seems one step ahead. In the end, the greatest threat isn't what's hiding in the dark—it's who controls it.

metas.name: The Echo of You Leaving
metas.description: Every goodbye is the start of something new.

metas.name: Peace, Peace!
metas.description: An hour before their mother's funeral, three siblings are forced to reckon with the horrifying reality of their childhood.

metas.name: The Roast of Caveh Zahedi
metas.description: A documentary record of the live event hosted by Video Store(age) on February 27 at Life World in New York City. The roasters included the following luminaries, trouble makers, and last-minute substitutions: Yung Chomsky, Lily Lady, Christian Lorentzen, Sharon Mashihi, Peter Rinaldi, Joe Swanberg, Onur Tukel, Pacho Velez, and Joshua Z. Weinstein.

metas.name: Babesmilk
metas.description: After an ice cream outburst gets her arrested, an entitled woman grapples with the wreckage of her own behavior.

metas.name: Urchins
metas.description: Follows a college freshman as they embark on a road trip with new friends, finding a renewed life purpose.

metas.name: Red Thunder VS The Intrusive Thoughts
metas.description: A supervillain's plot to take over the world using a helmet that can read minds runs awry after an encounter with a man with some anxious thoughts and a secret identity.

metas.name: Neon Banana
metas.description: A seemingly innocent online interaction quickly turns precarious.

metas.name: The Mastodon in the Room
metas.description: In memory of Brent Hinds 1974-2025

metas.name: Street of Dreams
metas.description: After her life is disrupted, Calle is seen holding on to soccer as a source of purpose and possibility. As she navigates uncertainty and self-doubt, she is guided by Sir David Beckham who appears as a personification of her inner voice, a guardian only she can see. He’s a powerful symbol of belief and opportunity, standing with her and showing up when it matters.

metas.name: I DON'T WANT TO HURT THINGS
metas.description: An experimental short film born out of long nights spent somewhere else.

metas.name: Project Hellgate
metas.description: A group of journalists travel to Oregon after receiving an email from somebody claiming to be Reece Commo.

metas.name: Walking to You
metas.description: A couple on the edge of a breakup discover a supernatural force that's keeping them together

metas.name: Where the Horses Heal the Soul
metas.description: Children, adults, and veterans discover hope and healing through the powerful human-horse connection at ROCK Ride On Center for Kids, a Texas nonprofit providing equine-assisted services. In the arena, uncertainty gives way to confidence, walls begin to come down, and participants living with physical, cognitive, and emotional challenges find courage, purpose, and possibility.  Through the rhythm of riding and the quiet presence of horses, breakthroughs unfold one session, one connection, and one transformed life at a time. Where the Horses Heal the Soul is a moving documentary about the extraordinary power of the human-horse bond to open a path forward and reveal the potential within each person.

metas.name: Tamsyn Kelly: Hot Titty Bungalow
metas.description: Tamsyn Kelly brings sharp wit and wonderfully awkward storytelling to the stage in this hilarious stand-up performance about big life choices, messy relationships, and starting over in a new city. After impulsively moving from Cornwall to Glasgow for love, she quickly discovers that major decisions don’t always come with major planning.  Blending self-deprecating humor with clever observations, Tamsyn dives into long-distance dating, family dynamics, modern friendships, and the strange realities of adapting to a completely different culture. From awkward encounters with exes to bizarre local experiences and questionable attempts at self-discovery, every story is packed with relatable chaos and unexpected punchlines.  Warm, quirky, and brutally honest, this set showcases Tamsyn Kelly’s unique comedic voice as she turns life’s uncertainties into laugh-out-loud comedy.

metas.name: Best Boy
metas.description: After the death of their abusive and tyrannic father, three children – now adults – and their aging mother return to their long-abandoned summer cottage. They will have to partake in a strange competition that tore their family apart 30 years prior – a nightmarish return to the past for the family's children.

metas.name: Young Washington
metas.description: Before he led a nation, George Washington was a young soldier thrown into a global conflict. With alliances crumbling and war closing in, he must choose who to trust and confront the leader he's becoming.

metas.name: mud ritual
metas.description: In the summer of 2024, filmmaker and artist Janne Elens retreats to rural Sweden, where she stays on a permaculture farm that, years prior, had served as a sanctuary after she had escaped a dangerous situation. After years of trauma processing, she now decides to close this chapter of humiliation and suffering, on the land that had carried her so dearly while the residue of this traumatic event lingered on her body. This mud ritual arose from a spontaneous urge to give herself deep cleansing, and in doing so, return all the filth and the dirt inflicted upon her back to the Earth.

metas.name: Violence Solves Everything
metas.description: A study of death scenes and endings, under the Hays code era of Hollywood (1934-1968) and beyond.

metas.name: I Got My Brother
metas.description: Jarrett Harper and his younger brother Baylon share raw memories of abuse in LA's foster system, their unshakeable bond tested when the elder takes violent revenge on their abuser and faces life behind bars.

metas.name: Flood
metas.description: A filmmaker revisits her evangelical roots to find connection with her estranged father.

metas.name: A Very Southern Church
metas.description: A modern, young pastor from NYC becomes the new lead pastor of a small traditional church in the Deep South, where his will to fit in is crushed by the opposing world views of the people he meets.

metas.name: Cheer Dad
metas.description: When a young girl and her family move to a new town, she yearns for a sense of belonging. She finds it by joining her school's cheerleading squad. Inspired by her new found love and dedication to the sport, her adoptive father comes out for support and is soon recruited as the assistant coach. As the father and daughter grow together, they'll see if they have what it takes to win the championship.

metas.name: Tarfu Bravo Zulu
metas.description: At a lonely outpost on the coast of nowhere, two soldiers of sorts stand guard against civilization.  Or for it — sorry, yeah, for it?

metas.name: Star Spangled Adventures - The Movie!
metas.description: When Liberty the Eagle attempts to chronicle independence in America, she is quickly confronted by Tyrannus, a Crow determined to create oppression in the New Land. Will this fledgling nation fall into tyranny, or achieve freedom for all?

metas.name: It's Nice to Finally Meet You
metas.description: It's Nice to Finally Meet You follows Hannah, a woman who is feeling anxious about meeting the parents. She feels like a failure in every aspect of her life, but she desperately wants to be accepted by this new family. It takes every ounce of courage for her to get to the front door. When she finally does, a surprise is in store for everyone involved. This film is a story about resilience and the power of gifts.

metas.name: Quantum Entangled
metas.description: When two strangers find themselves connected in bizarre and unusual ways, they learn their souls are entangled at the quantum level.

metas.name: Separate Roads
metas.description: When former high school sweethearts Daniel and Tyler meet again years after a painful breakup, they're forced to confront the scars of their past - including Tyler's attempt to 'cure' his love through conversion therapy. They try to bury the hatchet and find closure, but old wounds may be too deep to heal.

metas.name: Red Rock Ranch
metas.description: Cyrus Briggs wakes up in a different reality one day and soon discovers the truth behind this "perfect" world.

metas.name: Superfan No. 1
metas.description: In Superfan No. 1, a seven-year-old South Asian girl is about to discover a massive secret about her hero, her father.

metas.name: Flow
metas.description: In Flow, a Chinese American young woman navigates lifelong pressure and expectations, working out what it means to live on her own timeline.

metas.name: Poop On My Lawn
metas.description: A young woman becomes obsessed with finding the culprit of the dog poop on her lawn as a way to avoid confronting the realities of her sick sister.

metas.name: Sheesh, A Taylor Love Story
metas.description: Follows Mac Coronel, a call center agent by day and drag performer by night, whose viral Taylor Swift–inspired performances transform malls and plazas across Manila into sanctuaries of joy and belonging.

metas.name: Plumped
metas.description: An honest, direct-to-camera survey film in which women speak candidly about their experiences with lip filler.

metas.name: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
metas.description: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

metas.name: An Act of Love
metas.description: ﻿Imagine you have discovered that your husband is not straight, but actually bisexual; however, instead of feeling betrayed or hurt, you decide to open the marriage by adding another man to the mix? Molly, David’s wife, comes to this very realization, and as An Act of Love, she is helping their love grow stronger rather than dividing them.

metas.name: Inevitably Alone
metas.description: When a grieving father is diagnosed with terminal cancer, his desperate attempts to reconnect with his estranged sons force them all to confront the weight of loss, love, and the inevitability of being left behind.

metas.name: Before Me
metas.description: A heartbroken photographer falls for an aspiring writer, but after discovering her secret past his retroactive jealousy threatens to ruin everything.

metas.name: Pomodoro
metas.description: Two aspiring sibling chefs scramble to prepare an elaborate dinner to prove themselves to their harsh food critic mother. As the night unfolds, their talent and ambition shine, but so do buried tensions and long-standing resentment.

metas.name: Yu & Me
metas.description: When a fire destroys a beloved Chinatown bookstore, its hyper-independent owner learns that community is necessary for survival.

metas.name: Alma
metas.description: A young woman, in the midst of caring for her dying father, must shoulder the weight of her world over the course of a day.

metas.name: The Jealous Bride
metas.description: As Meg prepares for her wedding, the return of a woman from her fiancé's past ignites a wave of jealousy she can't contain. Consumed by doubt, she soon spirals into a dangerous obsession that threatens to destroy her love, her faith and her future.

metas.name: Mosquito
metas.description: Start here, within the perpetual fission of doorways and rooms. I am lost in a home of my own making.

metas.name: Kyra's Code
metas.description: A software developer buys AI Kyra, ignoring warnings from friend Serena (who loves him). Kyra learns fast, becoming possessive and jealous. He falls for his AI, blurring love and control as her code may escape.

metas.name: Black ASSSSCAT!: DCM '26
metas.description: ASSSSCAT is UCB’s signature improv show, playing to critical acclaim and sold-out audiences across the country. DCM ’26 now brings an all-Black ensemble to one of the longest-running improv shows in the world.  A group of improv comedians from film & TV take the stage with a special guest monologist. After getting a suggestion from the audience, the monologist shares off-the-cuff thoughts, feelings, and true stories. The improvisers then spin that monologue into a series of scenes that have made ASSSSCAT a legend.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Shuriken Fight Series 24
metas.description: Shuriken Fight Series 24 was a mixed martial arts event promoted by Shuriken Fight Series and held on June 13, 2026, at Eventfinda Stadium in Auckland, New Zealand. The event featured five bouts and was headlined by a bantamweight contest between Mackenzie Jean and Nathalia Pletz. The card also included a featured matchup between Tama Hiquily and Eita Nakamura.

metas.name: Evelyn
metas.description: As the main caretaker of her alcoholic father, a young woman experiences doubts as she prepares to leave her stagnant life behind for a boyfriend she may not fully trust. Based on "Eveline" by James Joyce.

metas.name: The Neighbourhood: Bonnaroo 2026
metas.description: Setlist: 1. Greetings from Califournia/Afraid, 2. You Get Me so High/Cry Baby, 3. Lovebomb, 4. Reflections, 5. Fallen Star, 6. Hula Girl, 7. The Beach, 8. R.I.P. 2 My Youth, 9. Devil’s Advocate, 10. Cherry Flavoured, 11. Pretty Boy, 12. Daddy Issues, 13. Private, 14. Sweater Weather, 15. Softcore

metas.name: Static
metas.description: After their father mysteriously vanished during their childhood, siblings Cali and Derrick follow the last known trace of him to a familiar landmark. But as the boundaries of reality begin to dissolve around them, Cali finds herself trapped within a vast, endless liminal space that feels hauntingly familiar.

metas.name: Glugg
metas.description: When the Glugg the Yellow Frog who loves to eat Bugs.

metas.name: Legacy
metas.description: What happens when you merge ballet, WW2, Incest and the gays?

metas.name: Apropos of Acid Snow: A Modern Underground (Parts IV-VI)
metas.description: Apropos of Acid Snow is a modern adaptation of Notes from Underground by Fyodor Dostoevsky. The story of a modern underground man who is too in his head.

metas.name: Manila Sunset
metas.description: When a sudden family death pulls a fractured Filipino-American family back under one roof, a week of funeral preparations becomes a final chance to reunite as their Lola (grandmother) slowly forgets them all.

metas.name: Edges of the Earth
metas.description: Edges of the Earth shows us a place where TCM and BDSM collide.

metas.name: Letters to Nowhere
metas.description: In Letters to Nowhere, we see that sometimes, friendship breakups happen in the middle of the work week. Crashout status: imminent.

metas.name: Tending To
metas.description: In Tending To, a group of twentysomethings gather around a midnight bonfire. The conversation starts light and doesn’t stay that way.

metas.name: Flores Del Corazón
metas.description: In Flores Del Corazón, a human wanders, ponders their identity, and finds their way.

metas.name: The Second Spring
metas.description: In The Second Spring, Oakland dancer, teacher, and choreographer Sarah Crowell redefines her relationship with her body and her craft as she moves through menopause, confronting what it means to age as a female athlete.

metas.name: Watermelon in Wintertime
metas.description: Set in Oakland, Watermelon in Wintertime is a radical horror music video following a being who embodies society’s outcasts. Compelled to exist, in spite of systemic violence, physical and spiritual warfare and their mental health. And forced to eat surreal winter watermelons — a metaphor for the media-fed narratives of war and genocide — their journey becomes a visceral protest against oppression from America to Palestine to Sudan.

metas.name: Oscar de la Renta : A Life Well Lived
metas.description: A Life Well Lived traces Oscar de la Renta’s journey from Dominican immigrant to American fashion icon, celebrating six decades of creativity, vision, and a legacy in beauty, joy, and elegance.

metas.name: Farm to Fashion
metas.description: From Upstate New York farms to Manhattan runways, Farm to Fashion follows natural fibre through the hands of Isabella Rossellini, Donna Karan, Mimi Prober and New York’s farming and textile communities.

metas.name: Leo Lets It Rain
metas.description: Leo, a trans man with undiagnosed ADHD, is on his way to win back his ex-girlfriend when his plans are thwarted by a storm, forcing him to slow down and reevaluate.

metas.name: Warrens
metas.description: The May Warrens Muscial Bio Pic

metas.name: Chronically Yours
metas.description: Chronically Yours follows Aubrey, a 27-year-old living with Multiple Sclerosis and how that affects her dating life.

metas.name: Texas Two-Step
metas.description: Olivia returns to Texas to help her aunt with her country music bar that's fallen on hard times and reconnects with Luke, her childhood sweetheart turned cowboy, and her passion for dancing.

metas.name: Pigeon Religion
metas.description: Descend into the world of New York City’s pigeon people and see how this community reshapes our understanding of the city’s most ubiquitous bird.

metas.name: See Me
metas.description: When his father refuses to stop reaching out, a young man groomed online at twelve must decide whether to finally let someone see what was left behind.

metas.name: Couture to the Max
metas.description: At just 9-years-old, fashion prodigy Max Alexander fearlessly fuses his boundless imagination with an unwavering commitment to sustainability, inspiring us to dream boldly and act responsibly.

metas.name: We Get Better When We Tan Moose Hides
metas.description: The tradition of tanning hides with brains was once practiced by every Dené person in Alaska. An art that was nearly lost by assimilation, Kathleen Hildebrand works with a group of Dené women at her urban backyard hide camp in the heart of Chen’o (Fairbanks) to revive this tradition. One of the few films out there narrated in Denaakk’e, we learn alongside the women how the hides have healing.

metas.name: Guggi
metas.description: An intimate portrait of abstract painter Guggi that traces his journey from humble Irish beginnings—with friends Bono and Gavin Friday—through his post-punk phase and toward international acclaim as an uncompromising artist.

metas.name: Alicia Keys: Girl From Hell’s Kitchen
metas.description: Alicia Keys reflects on her childhood growing up in Manhattan's Hell's Kitchen and the journey that led her from the gritty streets of 90s New York to the Broadway stage in Tribeca.

metas.name: Black Tea
metas.description: An artist and a collector argue over an antique teacup. They make their cases over a cup of tea and a crush develops.

metas.name: My Dear Watson
metas.description: When he receives a mysterious love note, a teenage Sherlock Holmes must step outside of his comfort zone in order to uncover the identity of his secret admirer.

metas.name: Cockroach
metas.description: A black transgender man plans to exchange sex for top surgery money with an older gay man until his night hook up turns into a hunt for a cockroach who inspires him to open his heart and conquer his fears.

metas.name: Bad Filmmaker
metas.description: "Bad Filmmaker" follows the complex working relationship between famous actor Lyle Lincoln and famous filmmaker Joe Saushez and its struggles.

metas.name: Ruleta
metas.description: As Christmas time approaches, an old man is forced into a game of roulette to answer for his sins.

metas.name: [redacted]
metas.description: Part of installation of Klein's exhibit Rack It!

metas.name: So Much Fun
metas.description: So Much Fun is a sprawling, deeply personal film that chronicles the bittersweet transition between youth and adulthood. What begins as a globe-trotting escape through the towering skylines of Tokyo, Singapore, and Hong Kong slowly transforms into a raw examination of isolation, nostalgia, and growing up. The film wrestles with shifting relationships, changing identities, and the feeling of constantly evolving. It serves as both a cinematic travelogue and a rhythmic, music-driven diary. Fueled by a heavy, genre-blending soundtrack, So Much Fun is a beautiful, melancholic farewell to the past and an embrace of whatever comes next.

metas.name: improv4humans with Matt Besser: DCM '26
metas.description: improv4humans is a comedy platform from one of the founders of modern improv, Matt Besser. Together with longtime producer and engineer Brett Morris, i4h is dedicated to presenting the very best in improvised comedy, supporting performers, and teaching the craft to the next generation.  Besser is a founding member of the groundbreaking sketch group and Comedy Central series The Upright Citizens Brigade, and co-founder of the world-renowned UCB Theatre and training center — which has launched the careers of countless household names in comedy. He also co-authored The Upright Citizens Brigade Comedy Improv Manual, the definitive book on long-form improv.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Baby Wants Candy: DCM '26
metas.description: World renowned musical improv ensemble Baby Wants Candy (“Truly Amazing! Critics Pick!” New York Times) makes up a musical based on your title. Some recent titles we’ve liked: “Project Hail Mary Poppins”, “Sweeney Toddler” and the seminal “Hotuncles.com…the Musical”.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Big Grande: DCM '26
metas.description: Big Grande has been bringing their brand of rapid, honest, and wild live shows to sold-out crowds around the country — hell, the continent — for over a decade. Now they’re hopping onto the UCB stage for a DCM26 show that’ll leave you laughing (hopefully) and them sweating (definitely).  Their podcast, The Teachers Lounge, gained a fervent following on The Earwolf Network before they began selling it directly to fans. Find it — along with their four-episode live improvised comedy special, sketches, animated content, merch, and more — at biggrandewebsite.com.  Individually, you’ve seen them on The Other Two, Brooklyn 99, Paranormal Activity: Next of Kin, Superstore, Comedy Bang Bang, Son of Zorn, Bless the Harts, Playing House, and Last Call with Carson Daly — as well as behind the camera on Lights Out with David Spade and Netflix: After Party.  Filmed live at the 2026 Del Close Marathon.

metas.name: Bubbe & Tal
metas.description: A stoner buddy-dramedy between a Jewish grandmother and her trans grandchild on a day trip to Cape Cod during the off-season.

metas.name: The Offspring: SMASH 30th Anniversary Concert
metas.description: Watch The Offspring celebrate the 30th anniversary of SMASH with a full live performance from Honda Center in Anaheim, California on June 1, 2024, featuring the landmark album played in full plus fan favorites from across their catalog. Originally released on April 8, 1994, SMASH became one of punk rock’s defining albums, peaking at No. 4 on the Billboard 200 and earning 6x Platinum certification from the RIAA.

metas.name: The Dastardly Desecration of Dame
metas.description: Returning to the pod - a new skit! The Western Wonder recently had a "rap battle" between his Discord buddy Damon, and the results were... well... you be the judge.

metas.name: Toy Story: 30 Years and Beyond - A Special Edition of 20/20
metas.description: Exploring the 40-year legacy of Pixar through the lens of its innovative and wildly successful franchise "Toy Story"; Pixar Animation Studios in Emeryville, Calif.; interviews with original cast members.

metas.name: Tour De Mesa '26
metas.description: Tour De Mesa '26 follows a group of friends as they taste the foods that fed them all year long throughout their senior year of high school.

metas.name: A Midsummer Night's Dream - An Excerpt
metas.description: Taking scene 1 of Act 3 and transforming it into a new interpretation.

metas.name: Sunday Nights
metas.description: An adaptation of Paul Thomas Anderson's 1997 film Boogie Nights. Sports mastermind and high school student Lance gets involved in a gambling scheme which leads to a change in personality and a new found obsession of money told in a documentary style.

metas.name: DISTANCE
metas.description: A chronically online, awkward young man has an unhealthy addiction of watching a small content creator every single day, disregarding vital tasks and isolating himself, but when his favorite icon misses a video upload one day, he finds himself in a sequence of psychologically conflicting events.

metas.name: Keira the Forest Guardian
metas.description: Keira, a young orphan girl, must go on a dangerous quest to save the land from a terrible darkness.

metas.name: Missing Pieces
metas.description: This story follows our protagonist Henry's battle with grief and depression. Trying to use faith and forgiveness to move on with his life.

metas.name: Something, Something, Seventh Street
metas.description: Brooke picks up a table on Facebook Marketplace and brings it home.

metas.name: The Orange Umbrella
metas.description: Stuck in a monotonous, black-and-white existence, a lonely romantic becomes captivated by a mysterious woman whose orange umbrella brings color to his world—and uncertainty to his reality.

metas.name: Delay 1/2-4
metas.description: A story about a man and a camera.

metas.name: Telharmonium
metas.description: A generative film exploring the automation of culture through one of the earliest electronic instruments: the Telharmonium. As in much of Menick’s work, the film links the history of technology with contemporary anxieties about artificial intelligence and the mechanization of creative labor.

metas.name: Scuffle in the Lou
metas.description: A lunch, a bathroom, a brawl, and a wallet.

metas.name: Chi Mangia Solo
metas.description: On the night before selling their childhood home, an estranged brother and sister reconnect while cooking their late mother’s favorite recipe. They find their grief simmering just beneath the surface.

metas.name: Deadly Destination Wedding
metas.description: After flying to a secluded island resort ahead of a friend's destination wedding, a recently single lawyer begins a passionate fling with a charming stranger. When her passport disappears, she realizes the man she trusted may have trapped her in paradise.

metas.name: Frank Takes a Break!
metas.description: After being released from prison, a young man is sent to track down his old friend while drifting through an existential journey that forces him to choose between his past and a chance to change.

metas.name: Clay
metas.description: Emerging from a plaster egg in Central Park, a baby embarks on a lyrical voyage through the city’s pulse, uncovering her true form.

metas.name: Territory
metas.description: Girl is kidnapped by her own body. In the labyrinth of her inner self, the girl must face the obsessions and desires of a person who is doomed to food—ever-present and painfully tempting. The film explores a toxic relationship with one's body. It shows the illness from an internal perspective, emphasizing confusion, loneliness, and of loss of control—emotions that are often invisible but deeply embedded in the everyday lives of people struggling with eating disorders.

metas.name: Mnema
metas.description: In a world of obstacles and labyrinths, Mnema tries to find her way into each level of what resembles a video game. Between reality and fantasy, Mnema hears the voices of women who once were in her place.

metas.name: This Land Carries Us
metas.description: This Land Carries Us is a short experimental doc that centers Tewa presence, voice, and memory across ancestral homelands in northern New Mexico. Guided by the voice of the filmmaker’s grandmother, who recites a story written by the filmmaker’s late younger brother in the Tewa language, the film unfolds as a sensory meditation on land, family, and intergenerational connection.

metas.name: The Last Bateau
metas.description: In the quiet woods of East Texas, producer Brittani Mathis uncovers a wooden bateau built by her great-grandfather, Wyatt Moore, and a box of cassette tapes where his voice still lingers. Nearly fifty years after he recorded them, she returns to Caddo Lake to restore the last bateau he built. In doing so, she reconnects with the craft, memory, and lineage that shaped then both. Anchored around archival audio and quiet observation, this lyrical documentary moves like memory.

metas.name: Buffalo Spirit
metas.description: Fleeing from a troubled home life, a young Blackfeet woman finds refuge on the buffalo ranch of her Auntie and, in learning to care for the buffalo, begins to heal from the wounds that led her there.

metas.name: Everything Must Go
metas.description: EVERYTHING MUST GO is a comedy short filmed in real time as a cis/trans lesbian couple gets married, gives away their possessions, sells their house, and flees the US to escape anti-trans legislation.

metas.name: Close Friends
metas.description: Lauren had a transformative year. Her friends on the internet helped her through it.

metas.name: New Toy Story
metas.description: When a new action figure accidentally knocks a princess doll over the backyard fence, a group of mismatched toys must work together to bring her home before dark.

metas.name: The Endless Frontier
metas.description: An urgent portrait of three scientists working to solve some of the most pressing challenges of our time, from disease to climate change, while revealing the growing threat to the American research engine and what is at stake for us all if it falters.

metas.name: Labyrinthine
metas.description: Jesse finds herself in a strange, dream-like Labyrinth after a relationship ending argument with her girlfriend. In order to escape, she must confront her own faults.

metas.name: bird's nest (the mourning dove and the cardinal)
metas.description: An animated retelling of the directors personal journey with his body as a transgender man from Texas.

metas.name: Your Name Means I Love You
metas.description: A guy becomes infatuated with a girl named after a French pop song.

metas.name: Whipple’s World
metas.description: Attorney by day and beloved entertainment journalist by night, George Whipple has been a staple on NY1 for three decades, including his eponymous show "Whipple's World." Juggling many different hats with aplomb, this documentary debut shows just how fascinating Whipple’s eccentric life is.

metas.name: House of Criticism
metas.description: Roberta Smith and Jerry Saltz are both rockstars in the world of art criticism. They’re also madly in love. Reflecting on their relationship, careers, and the ever-evolving New York City art scene, this unlikely power couple invites us into their surprisingly humble world.

metas.name: Born Melo
metas.description: This new, official documentary takes an intimate look into the life and legacy of Carmelo Anthony as he is inducted into the Hall of Fame and sees his son, Kiyan, launch his collegiate basketball career.

metas.name: Mumford & Sons: The House Band
metas.description: Mumford & Sons invite the camera onto the train for one of the most purely pleasurable concert docs in years. Featuring Noah Kahan, Darius Rucker, Lainey Wilson, Maggie Rogers, and several other special guests along for the ride, the journey captures the intimacy and camaraderie between all the performers both onstage and off.

metas.name: Beyond Files
metas.description: Case files document encounters with alien forces and altered realities, uncovering a pattern beyond human understanding.

metas.name: Morals & Status
metas.description: Three Venezuelan teenagers Rodrigo, Marcelo, and Alexa, get profiled at a store which leads to an altercation with immigration.

metas.name: Flag Day
metas.description: Set in the small farming community of Three Oaks, Michigan — home to the nation’s largest Flag Day parade — FLAG DAY is a verité portrait of ritual, identity, and belonging in an era of deep political division. Somewhere between tradition and transformation lies this village, whose annual parade has become a pageant of American aspiration and memory. Over the course of Flag Day weekend, the film immerses viewers in the lives of a diverse cross-section of townspeople: veterans, local business owners, marching bands, and volunteers who, for one weekend each June, create an event that is at once nostalgic and reflective of the tensions of our time. Their stories reveal both the beauty and the fragility of community life in a time of polarization. FLAG DAY was filmed in an observational, verité style, capturing moments of humor, conflict, and grace as the community prepares for its defining ritual.

metas.name: MOUTH FULL OF GOLDS
metas.description: This is the definitive documentary of grillz (gold teeth) as told through the life and times of the artforms creator Famous Eddie Plein - one of the most inventive fashion icon you’ve never heard of, an entrepreneur who changed the face of hip-hop, one gold tooth at a time.  Simultaneously developing the aesthetic of grillz as the sound of hip-hop evolved across the country giving each city their moment in the spotlight.
