The story of a man who found him self at the epicentre of the hip-hop, Miami bass, Southern Rap and Chopped and Screwed music scenes.  A natural born hustler whose customer base comprised of rap superstars, millionaire drug dealers, gangsters and fashion focused teenagers. An icon that built and then lost an empire after the world went digital and moved on-line without him.

metas.name: Swamped
metas.description: A 19 year old college student named Rowan lives through a day in her life, which means constant agony in her own brain. Rowan is trapped in a battle with herself, dealing with her obsessions and compulsions, as well as trying to adjust to a new social life.

metas.name: The Call
metas.description: A young actress comes face to face with a volatile composer at the biggest callback of her career.

metas.name: The Intimacy Coordinator
metas.description: Kate is an intimacy coordinator. She is also a sex addict.

metas.name: Learning to Eat Cake
metas.description: An outgoing young woman reframes a strange and coercive sexual encounter as a comical tale to her friends in order to make light of the violation.

metas.name: Badland Rising
metas.description: An ordinary bloke embarks on a 19-hour drive home, unaware of being pursued by two unhinged criminals. Once he discovers their motive, his journey turns into a brutal fight for survival.

metas.name: Blue Film
metas.description: Drawn by the promise of easy money and anonymous sex, queer camboy Aaron Eagle is shocked to discover a personal connection with the mysterious stranger who has paid for his company. Over the course of one night, the two men engage in a war of words and emotions as they wrestle with the impact of a tainted and shared past.

metas.name: Seven Deadly Sins
metas.description: A young sword swinging student avenges his master by rejecting the seven deadly sins.

metas.name: FULL DISCLOSURE: THE REALITY BEHIND SPIELBERG'S DISCLOSURE DAY
metas.description: An exclusive look at the making of "Disclosure Day," featuring interviews with Steven Spielberg, Emily Blunt and more, hosted by Gadi Schwartz.

metas.name: Sofia
metas.description: A quick waxing session turns into a nightmare when a Brazilian gets a brazilian.

metas.name: Real Couples
metas.description: Me and my girl fight a lot, it’s honestly why I’m in therapy. Is every couple like this or are my friends better than me?

metas.name: Sonder
metas.description: Taking place in the same apartment complex, three individual stories explore the perspectives of three different stages of life. A young college girl who has just moved into the complex, a couple balancing life together, and an older woman whose son is helping her move out of the complex after the death of her husband.

metas.name: Propeller One-Way Night Coach
metas.description: During the golden age of aviation, a young airplane enthusiast and his mother embark on a cross-country journey to Hollywood—and their simple flight transforms into the trip of a lifetime.

metas.name: Prison and Time
metas.description: Formerly incarcerated writer Marvin Wade speaks personally about his 25 years in prison and the positive transformation he achieved in spite of, not because of, the criminal legal system around him.

metas.name: Over Your Dead Body
metas.description: A dysfunctional couple head to a remote cabin to "reconnect", but each has secret intentions to kill the other.

metas.name: Moronic Courtship
metas.description: A young nerd who is foolish and bullied by fellow youths, finds a girl and falls head over heels but must face the harsh truth and be taught the true meaning of living from a one above.

metas.name: Small Hours
metas.description: Struggling with alcohol addiction and mental illness, an artist reaches out to an old friend.

metas.name: The Story of Documentary Film: 1970s
metas.description: From Mark Cousins, creator of the groundbreaking The Story of Film: A New Generation & Women Make Film, comes the definitive history of documentary. Tracing the evolution of documentary film across time, encompassing landmark works and hidden treasures, while revealing how the form has helped us see and make sense of our world.

metas.name: GENESIS
metas.description: A widowed father unravels his conviction after being plagued with recurring nightmares of sacrificing his beloved daughter.

metas.name: Loser
metas.description: A heartbroken teen, Jared, stumbles to find new love and messes up along the way.

metas.name: The Princess Who Forges the Sun
metas.description: The Tinkerer Princess and her Mysterious Retainer to find a way to make light return to a sunless world.

metas.name: Foot Finders
metas.description: Embark on a wild adventure as Kyle Evans, a Sasquatch-hunting reality TV star, goes all in on a last ditch effort to save his failing show.

metas.name: The Last Pack
metas.description: Anxious soon to be father, Jackson, promises his pregnant girlfriend, Dylan, he’s done smoking for good. But after a quick trip to the gas station spirals out of control, he finds himself dragged back into old habits with old company on the night everything is supposed to change.

metas.name: Squatch
metas.description: After discovering a Sasquatch in the Smoky Mountains, park rangers Robert and Sam find themselves in over their heads when tech giant Alphazon plans to destroy its habitat. With no real authority and even less of a plan, they decide to relocate the creature themselves, driving it cross-country to the Pacific Northwest. Watch as Robert and Sam try to do one small, wildly impractical good thing.

metas.name: The Light-Bringer
metas.description: Nick Cash, a lifelong musician, spends most of his Tuesdays along with the band, SIDETRACKED, playing at assisted living centers to bring light into the lives of those who are lonely and tired! His love of music is contagious, and he truly loves all those around him! This documentary chronicles how he fell in love with music and how that led him to performing every week.

metas.name: Gabriel Rutledge: A Reasonable Hour
metas.description: Gabriel Rutledge performs a comedy special in Tacoma Washington, filmed at Tacoma Comedy Club.

metas.name: Alice
metas.description: After meeting what seems to be the man of her dreams on a website, Alice gets involved into a deep scheme which she can't seem to escape from.

metas.name: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
metas.description: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns to a bet that changes everything.

metas.name: Small Steps
metas.description: After settling in with her roommates Charlyne and Sophie, mute alien Stacey happily joins them on a trip from the Riverwest neighborhood in Milwaukee to Charlyne’s dear old dad in Chicago. If figuring out how best to take care of an alien lifeform wasn’t enough, the rogue CIA agent on their take might just make things worse. Whatever the case, the sheer independence of Stacey might be at stake.

metas.name: 2 Bro's Ideas
metas.description: With their Prod 2. due next week, Daniel and Logan can't decide on what to make. Daniel wants something classic and simple, while Logan wants . . . laptops to get stolen?

metas.name: Sword
metas.description: A captive prince falls asleep; in his dreams, his doppelgangers multiply—some imprisoned, some free—and they are all searching for the magnificent Sexcalibur, which could give new meaning to their lives.

metas.name: Enter Gustaffson
metas.description: The legendary anonymous painter known as Gustaffson reveals his identity in a groundbreaking documentary.

metas.name: The Last Laugh: Stephen Colbert
metas.description: For more than a decade, Stephen Colbert has sat at the center of late night, where comedy, politics and culture collide. As he prepares to take the desk for the final time, The Last Laugh turns its lens on both the show and the man, exploring what audiences stand to lose when one of satire’s sharpest and most thoughtful voices signs off. The hour also examines the broader cultural and political forces surrounding the end of Colbert’s late-night run and the future of outspoken comedy in an evolving landscape.  Anchoring the hour is a dynamic lineup of interviewees spanning comedy, journalism and cultural criticism. The special features appearances from CNN Anchor and Chief Washington Correspondent Jake Tapper and comedians Jordan Carlos and Gianmarco Soresi, alongside key creative voices from The Colbert Report including Allison Silverman and Richard Dahm, each offering insight into the scope and lasting influence of Colbert’s work.

metas.name: Ophira Eisenberg: I Used To Be Nicer
metas.description: Ophira Eisenberg gives a Canadian middle finger to toxic positivity, parenting, marriage maintenance, aging, therapy, and the goddamn cost of eggs.

metas.name: GCW: Guilty Conscience 2026
metas.description: The lawless energy of Game Changer Wrestling returns to the Motor City! GCW takes over the legendary Harpos Concert Theatre for "Guilty Conscience 2026." Known for its gritty atmosphere and die-hard fans, Detroit becomes the epicenter of independent wrestling as the promotion brings its unique blend of high-octane athleticism and ultraviolent chaos back to one of its favorite haunts.  Tag Team Warfare: The Pillars vs VNDL48  Women's Showcase: Allysin Kay vs Vipress  Singles Grudge Match: Dr. Redacted vs Anakin Murphy

metas.name: Last Night In..."Hollywood"
metas.description: A determined young actress takes on a mysterious errand for a manipulative casting director, crossing paths with a disgraced former actor. As their worlds collide, she’s forced to question how far she’s willing to go to make it in Hollywood.

metas.name: The Janitor
metas.description: After a confusing accident, 3 high school theater students are forced to deal with very.... serious cops.

metas.name: Damnation Empire
metas.description: A man is about to be executed. Before, during, or after his death, he remembers fragments of his past, and navigates to find and save himself.

metas.name: Inside The Works
metas.description: In 1974, an eccentric millionaire by the name of Alexander Schure founded the New York Inistitute of Technology's Computer Graphics Lab. Housed in a one hundred year old pink mansion in Long Island, the lab made large advances in digital paint, animation, and attempted to create the first computer animated film twice in its lifetime. Kickstarting Pixar, creating the alpha channel, and creating art with every new tool they could lay their hands on, this is the story of the forbidden pink house in Long Island.

metas.name: Sam Pauly: A Documentary
metas.description: The film, created and directed by acclaimed celebrity photographer and artist Jasper Soloff, traces the highs and lows of Sam Pauly’s career as she sits down in her Broadway dressing room recalling the sudden cancellation of a planned world tour which forced her to confront the possibility of walking away from the profession she had fought so hard to build a place in. With work disappearing overnight and the future of theater uncertain, Pauly wrestled with burnout, financial pressure, and painful questions faced by many performers.

metas.name: Telescope
metas.description: Stumbling on the mythical House of Lost Things, an explorer must choose between her missing childhood stuffed animal and a future-telling telescope with the answer to all her fears.

metas.name: You knew, I know
metas.description: The first month of Spring in the past and the present. A follow-up to “You Are Here”.

metas.name: "LEMON-HEAD!"
metas.description: A colorfully dressed hit-man (Breccan Conroy), haunted by his darker thoughts (DeChi Peterson), faces a life-altering choice: remain loyal to his violent career or risk everything for the girl who might save him (Lola Bazile). No matter what he decides, his past will soon follow.

metas.name: Deacon Blues
metas.description: On the morning of his best friend’s wedding, Edwin goes on a strange journey deciding whether to speak his mind or forever hold his peace.

metas.name: Automaton
metas.description: The Indigoing on the Streets finale culminates in a surrealist moving picture.

metas.name: The Right Way is the Wrong Way
metas.description: Roy is heading to a job interview but keeps getting lost. Along the way, he meets two characters who change his perspective on life.

metas.name: Fossilized
metas.description: Linnie lives with her Nana in the unincorporated territory of Villegreen, Colorado - notable only for a nearby paleontological site. When Nana’s memory begins to fail, Linnie goes looking for evidence of the past.

metas.name: Bug Behind Schedule
metas.description: Bug stayed up late procrastinating and fell asleep, only to find itself running late for film class. Waiting anxiously for it's pick-up and desperate for a solution, it finds a mysterious object behind the computer that might just be the key to getting to class on time. Time travel mishaps ensue.

metas.name: Death at the Dinner Party
metas.description: When a star psychology student dies during a faculty party, Andrea Gibbs and her son Ethan are drawn into the dangerous manipulations of renowned professor Alan Jackson, a man determined to bury the truth at any cost.

metas.name: Kubler
metas.description: The Campbell family is grieving the loss of their daughter and sister after a fatal accident in the midst of the holiday season. The family is sent into ethical turmoil, however, when the father brings her back in the form of a robot replacement that shares her personality and memories. Due to some technological complications and the nature of their situation, she is totally unable to live her life as she once did.

metas.name: Vacant Aisles
metas.description: Vacant Aisles follows Thomas and Annie who are trying to navigate through their uneventful lives, trying to make the most of the small things while being confronted with the fact they need to make a change.

metas.name: Don't Shoot The Messenger
metas.description: A pickup man and a small-time criminal both face a moral dilemma.

metas.name: Raunchy Round Up
metas.description: A struggling actress juggles her pretentious ex-boyfriend, rekindling an old flame, and the steamy film that might just be her big break.

metas.name: The Knock
metas.description: Philip, living a monotonous life, has an entity develop over him when he fails to reach out to his mom and can't get it to go away.

metas.name: Power Slap 20
metas.description: Power Slap 20: Trujillo vs. Johnson takes place on Friday, May 15, 2026, live from The Chelsea at The Cosmopolitan in Las Vegas. The event features a Lightweight Championship main event and streams for free on the Power Slap YouTube channel at 9 PM EST / 6 PM PST.

metas.name: A Rock Without a Role
metas.description: Beau is in search of his purpose. Everyone else around him seems to know theirs. But with the help of his friends, Beau finds his true purpose was right beside him all along.

metas.name: Apollo and I
metas.description: An awkward college student catches the gaze of an intriguing girl, unaware that she’s secretly a bloodthirsty vampire.

metas.name: Ultimate Spider-Man: Origins
metas.description: After the horrific death of Peter Parker, a new Spider-Man emerges. 17-year-old Miles Morales, bitten by a radioactive spider, becomes the new wall-crawler the city of New York needs. All the while, on his journey meets an unlikely ally.

metas.name: Jacob's Savings
metas.description: Jacob is hit with a financial crisis that he tries to resolve through the teachings of his idol, Rick Alton.

metas.name: The Highland Boutique
metas.description: When a world-famous rapper offers a dream job for watching over a suitcase full of weed, a recovering addict must resist the temptation of relapse to leave her boring job at a vintage clothing store.

metas.name: Purple Summer
metas.description: Connell Byrne, an idealistic coal miner who sees the way the world could be, wants nothing more than to leave his small Appalachian hometown with his best friend Lee. However, Lee sees the way the world is, and there’s one obstacle that stands between them.

metas.name: That Sinking Feeling
metas.description: Misty awakes with a cold in a bed unfamiliar to her. At the foot of the bed, the owner of the place, Ashton, obsessively attends to her. He claims to have saved Misty from an accident in which she drove her car into a lake. Misty has no memory of this event and questions why she would act in such a way in the first place. Instead of easing her worries, Ashton leaves Misty alone so she can rest, but promises to check back in later. While trapped alone in the room, increasingly strange occurrences happen to Misty, and glimpses of the accident begin to surface. What truly happened at the lake? Who is Ashton, and does he know more than he lets on?

metas.name: Aliens
metas.description: Two members of a foreign species crash land near a prep school dormitory, invading it and attacking the students within. But nothing is quite as it seems.

metas.name: Behind the 8 Ball
metas.description: A financially troubled high school senior bets her future on a pool tournament, only to discover that the real game is deciding what kind of life she wants to live.

metas.name: A15
metas.description: No one knows what happened to West Point—only that it never let go.

metas.name: Open Taxi
metas.description: Jessie and Margot meet by chance encounter at a house party the night of their high school graduation. What follows is a summer of adventure, and a year that will reveal their feelings towards relationships and the futures that will get in the way of theirs.

metas.name: Top Hat - The Musical
metas.description: Based on the classic 1935 RKO movie starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, Top Hat is a sparkling romantic cocktail laced with witty comedy, stunning choreography and tap-dancing brilliance, brought to life on stage with lavish sets and gorgeous costumes. Irving Berlin’s irresistible score includes some of Hollywood’s greatest songs, including the immortal Cheek to Cheek, Let’s Face the Music and Dance, Top Hat White Tie and Tails and Puttin’ on the Ritz.  When Broadway star Jerry Travers arrives in London to open a new show, he crosses paths with model Dale Tremont whose beauty sleep is rudely interrupted by Jerry tap dancing in the hotel suite above hers. Instantly smitten, Jerry vows to abandon his bachelor life to win her – but the path of true love never does run smooth.  Put on your top hat, brush off your tails and let this joyous romantic musical comedy sweep you off your feet!

metas.name: Irving Berlin's Top Hat
metas.description: Inspired by the iconic 1935 movie musical starring Fred Astaire and Ginger Rogers, this acclaimed Chichester Festival Theatre revival recorded from the West End in January 2026 is directed and choreographed by three-time Tony winner Kathleen Marshall.

metas.name: Dad Lifestyle
metas.description: Carter embarks on a profound journey through the world of fatherhood.

metas.name: Scene of the Mime
metas.description: A wily group of criminals must return to the scene of their last crime to cover their tracks.

metas.name: Murmur
metas.description: In a shifting, dreamlike world, a young girl begins to experience a changing body and the strange feelings it brings along.

metas.name: Lisa Ann Walter: It Was an Accident
metas.description: Lisa Ann Walter's long-awaited debut comedy special takes on feral Gen-Xers, self-loathing, and navigating a backsliding America, via the no-filter lens of a grown-ass woman who has been paying attention.

metas.name: The Accidental Renaissance of Steven Porter
metas.description: A man at the brink of existence. To be reborn. To become undone.

metas.name: Disco Hall Commitments
metas.description: "(...)the most important event of my day has been remembering the improbable adventure of H.K: 5000 years after the first kalaallit expedition, renowned and reviled archaeologist Herbjørg Kristofferson tries to lift up an ambitious budget for a reckless expedition to the Secret Pavilion of Monk Ko-Hu, near the Russian Arctic"

metas.name: Sugar Boy
metas.description: A short documentary film on the trials and triumphs of a young man's obesity journey.

metas.name: Tokyo In 33 RPM
metas.description: A musical journey through Tokyo's Jazz Cafes.

metas.name: Dire Duplicity
metas.description: A tormented secret agent with emotional and psychological problems attempts to stop an international cyber attack. This dark emotional mystery intensifies as he is betrayed by those he trusts and loves.

metas.name: A Guardian's Heart
metas.description: Jake Bishop has been an exemplary Executive Protection Medic with a distinguished career but life hasn't always been that way for him. There have been miscues, failures, wrong turns and one day he just decides to walk away from it all. His ex boss wants to hire him for one final mission together and when Jake senses redemption for all life's twist and turns, will they survive and can the thought of love save him just in time from a path of destruction. Only time will tell.

metas.name: A Last Look at the Glen Cove Taco Bell
metas.description: Jimmy Mullen looks back on his childhood at the Taco Bell in Glen Cove, NY, as it gets ready for renovations, reminiscing about memories of coming to this spot after school and how lots of modern architecture is losing a lot of its character. This Taco Bell stands as one of the final locations on Long Island that had not been given a recent makeover.

metas.name: The Crash
metas.description: A teen slams her car into a building, killing her boyfriend and his friend. What seems like a tragic accident becomes a murder case.

metas.name: Keep on Pushing
metas.description: Dirk has some car troubles.

metas.name: Drive On, Mr Otter!
metas.description: Timid Mr Otter is given one final chance to evict an elderly couple from their rural village home, or risk losing his own company issued housing.

metas.name: Enough Square
metas.description: Upon settling into a new town, an investigator encounters strange villagers, and a series of peculiar events unfold.

metas.name: Teen Gay Fairytale
metas.description: It's the height of promposal season and everyone at Small Town High School is dying to know which lucky lady will get asked by star lax bro Jax McCauley. But when the school gossips out him as gay, Jax finds himself peer pressured into dating the only other gay kid in school... even though they have nothing in common, and Jax is secretly in love with his best friend, Miller. This coming-of-age satire pokes fun at the way queer characters and romances are typically presented in mainstream media, while also aiming to normalize rather than sensationalize coming out.

metas.name: Candidates
metas.description: Nadia, a young adult grappling with loneliness, goes on a string of dates after her roommate and best friend, Lorelei, downloads a dating app to solve that problem, leading to a series of "bad dates." Until she meets Jack.

metas.name: Hope For The Guadalupe
metas.description: On July 4th, 2025, catastrophic flash flooding swept through the Texas Hill Country. The river rose more than 37 feet in a matter of hours, and entire communities along its banks were forever changed. In the days that followed, an extraordinary response unfolded. Search and rescue teams, volunteers, and organizations from across the state and the nation converged on the Guadalupe. As the land and river begin to recover, so too do the people who call it home.

metas.name: Dead Zones
metas.description: How does the abundance of HAB-forming phytoplankton species correlate with environmental and biological variables along the California Coast?

metas.name: Best Cinematography
metas.description: An experimental picture by lawson saby.

metas.name: Chet Rockwell & The Milky Mob
metas.description: Kipp Norman and his best friend, Margie sell black market margarine.  When Margie gets kidnapped during a deal, Kipp must enlist the help of the Midwest's most famous private investigator, Chet Rockwell to find his friend and expose the secret corruption of Wisconsin's dairy industry.

metas.name: Vera
metas.description: Vera is an experimental film that combines drawn-on-film and digital animation. The images unfold to the rhythm of music played by Vera Guilaroff, a pianist from Quebec that has now been forgotten by history. Guilaroff accompanied numerous silent films in Montreal movie theaters during the 1910s and 1920s. To our knowledge, this is the first time in nearly 100 years that her music has been used again in a film.

metas.name: Le bruit des nuages
metas.description: Because animals also dream. All birds, all mammals dream.

metas.name: N/A
metas.description: Emmy winner Holland Taylor and Broadway's Ana Villafañe star as two U.S. Representatives, generations apart, who couldn't be more different. Inspired by real people and events, the play N/A is a battle of wills and wits between N, the first woman Speaker of the House, and A, the youngest woman ever elected to Congress.  Filmed from Lincoln Center's Off-Broadway theater in August 2024, N/A is part of Theater Close-Up, a collaboration between THIRTEEN and New York City-area Off-Broadway and regional theaters, shining a primetime spotlight on a diverse mix of innovative theater productions.  Go behind closed doors as these two formidable women debate power, ambition, and change. N/A is written by Congressional aide turned playwright Mario Correa and directed by Tony Award-winning director Diane Paulus (“Jagged Little Pill”).

metas.name: Scissor Slasher
metas.description: Sapphic Horror Short Film

metas.name: I Created...
metas.description: Young woman has a epiphany after an hospital stay and feels compelled to live her dream.

metas.name: Bowling Bruce
metas.description: During a first date, a young man must try not to embarrass himself while introducing a girl to his best friend: Bruce, the bowling ball.

metas.name: Why is Nathan Missing?
metas.description: When his friend, Nathan, goes missing, Ellis tries to find him but only finds his answers making less and less sense.

metas.name: Dinner at Eight-Seventeen
metas.description: On their anniversary night, a couple sits down for dinner and confronts what the future of their relationship may look like after receiving news.

metas.name: The Busby Entanglement
metas.description: A film noir following a morally ambiguous French thief escaping the police.

metas.name: DOG DOG DOG
metas.description: A scarecrow and a pirate wander the desert looking for a boat before a cataclysmic flood wipes them out.

metas.name: The Sharp Edge
metas.description: After his father’s death, a young man continues to live under the weight of impossible expectations, questioning if he was ever truly enough for the man he tried so hard to impress.

metas.name: Summer Cruisin'
metas.description: Eddie Summers, the lead singer of Summer Cruisin', has been missing for 38 years until his hit song, “Midnight Knows My Name,” is rediscovered on social media. Looking for a way to online fame, Sean Campbell takes it upon himself to find Eddie and put on a show that will bring him back to the top.

metas.name: Kanto
metas.description: Kanto by Mary Francis Cheeseman is a 3D animated short film for The University of New Mexico

metas.name: Snowfall
metas.description: A lone gunslinger wanders a snow covered forest in search for something.

metas.name: The Bug
metas.description: Director Colby Schoetz makes an observation about the world around him only to have it shut down by a bug.

metas.name: Wishlist
metas.description: A man walks around a mall creating a wishlist made of various items.

metas.name: Acrophobia?
metas.description: A college-aged couple reaches a breaking point over his irrational fear of marginal heights.

metas.name: How to be Loved
metas.description: Through the lens of a 1950's educational video, we follow Oscar, a lonely yet romantic college professor, as he tries to understand how to be loved.

metas.name: Ghosts of Modernist Montreal
metas.description: Collage, drawn sound, and double exposure animations on 16mm film explore the temporal disjuncture of Montreal’s urban landscape, haunted by the ghosts of neighbourhoods that were demolished for Expo 67.

metas.name: People Like Ghosts
metas.description: A nighttime montage of strangers drifting through the city, People Like Ghosts is an experimental visual poem exploring modern isolation, silent routines, and the fragile distance between presence and disappearance.

metas.name: Prison of Light
metas.description: A man descends into a nightmarish digital world as he struggles desperately for human connection with a mysterious woman.

metas.name: Not Enough
metas.description: A young couple struggles with insecurities and anxiety while on vacation together.

metas.name: Apple Music Live: Lady Gaga MAYHEM Requiem
metas.description: For Apple Music Live, Gaga presents MAYHEM Requiem, a celebration and musical reimagining of MAYHEM.

metas.name: Excerpts of a Filibustered Friendship
metas.description: Two friends struggle to remain as such amid a radically shifting political landscape.

metas.name: Can't Hurry Love
metas.description: After a tough breakup, Xavier navigates his realationship with his best friend Amy, who obviously has feelings for him.

metas.name: Inspection
metas.description: A calculated stalker poses as a facility inspector and infiltrates a university to close in on his prey.

metas.name: The Day We Switched
metas.description: Chris and Jamie go through life without dealing with the consequences of their actions; until one day something powerful makes them walk in somebody else's shoes. AKA, a womans.

metas.name: Church Girl
metas.description: A discerning lesbian pretends to be Christian to score a date with the hot choir singer, finding herself at Bushwick’s oldest queer Bible study.

metas.name: Second Responders
metas.description: Second Responders is a short documentary exploring the emotional aftermath of the 2023 Lewiston mass shooting through the perspective of public school teachers. Often overlooked in conversations surrounding tragedy and recovery, educators were forced to become emotional anchors for grieving students while navigating their own fear, trauma, and uncertainty. Through intimate interviews and observational storytelling, the film examines the invisible burden teachers carry in the wake of violence and the quiet resilience required to return to the classroom after a community is forever changed.

metas.name: Just One More
metas.description: A recovering addict, Jess, meets Charles, a dying man praying God will use him "just one more" time. As their lives collide, Jess battles shame, and doubt-discovering faith, forgiveness, and the hope to fight for a future beyond addiction.

metas.name: You & Me
metas.description: Dual-screen movie created by two artists where images come into sync and drift apart.

metas.name: Night Plane
metas.description: Local filmmaker Salise Hughes returns with a dream about clouds and lightning and travel.

metas.name: In the Heavenly Cutting Room
metas.description: A woman on her deathbed chastises her creator in this fusion of stop-motion animation and dreamlike live-action video.

metas.name: The Traveller
metas.description: A guilt ridden man goes back in time to find and kill the person who he believes ruined his life.

metas.name: Where Are You Alice?
metas.description: In a "potential" future, the True Purity Act is enacted in the U.S.A. for "societal protection," forcing all declared traitors to be removed from each state and forced into special "rehabilitation" facilities. THIS IS ONE OF THEIR STORIES…

metas.name: Ray of the Sun
metas.description: At 24 years old, Manny sets foot in the United States for the first time. This short story recounts a pivotal moment when Manny walked into Wildcard Boxing Gym and met legendary trainer Freddie Roach. It marks the beginning of their iconic partnership and chronicles Manny's journey from an unknown fighter to one of boxing's all-time greats.

metas.name: No Sex
metas.description: A college girl must navigate her unspoken feelings for her best friend — and race to protect her — when a drunken night spirals out of control.

metas.name: Tunggu Sekejap
metas.description: Two people meet for the first time.

metas.name: The Golden Age
metas.description: Fictional silent film star Jack Valentine struggles to make the transition to talking pictures during the golden age of Hollywood.

metas.name: It's Cold!
metas.description: Two girls go swimming!

metas.name: Don't Doubt
metas.description: Five strangers. Five impossible beliefs. One chain reaction that proves they all have enough hope. except one… don’t doubt.

metas.name: Rabbitfoot
metas.description: In the midst of the Vietnam War, four friends are convinced they’re safe from the draft. But, there’s one final wrench in the works… and it takes the form of a letter.

metas.name: Snail Mail
metas.description: A snail embarks on a long journey to deliver the mail.

metas.name: I'm Fine
metas.description: When her friend calls to check in, Tori is asked a simple question. We hear everything she would say: the anxiety, the feeling of being trapped inside her own mind and body, the exhaustion of it all. But when the moment comes, she says nothing. She never does.

metas.name: The Tales of Mission and Zaalbar
Bite Back
metas.description: At the end of their first date, Lexie tries to let Tristan down easy. Unable to handle the rejection, Tristan kidnaps Lexie to “teach her a lesson” with the help of his friends Luke and Kyle. However, their arrogance quickly wears off as they realize that they are in over their heads and they kidnapped the wrong girl.

metas.name: Bailey's Blues
metas.description: In 1960s France, a jazz musician becomes the subject of an impromptu documentary.

metas.name: Corked
metas.description: Undercover cop Luca is sent to infiltrate one of the UK's largest drug empires-unaware that internal fractures have left the organisation on the brink of collapse, and new, volatile powers are rising to claim control.

metas.name: Grow
metas.description: In the self-proclaimed ‘Pumpkin Capital of the World’, no-nonsense curmudgeonly farmer Dinah Little takes in her estranged niece Charlie, who decides to enter the local pumpkin growing competition where she and the other growers face fierce competition, sabotage, and a genetically engineered rival.

metas.name: High Noon
metas.description: A group of teens execute a robbery -- and then it hits them...

metas.name: Legendary Tigers of India
metas.description: Tiger expert Valmik Thapar uncovers 50 years of archival footage, chronicling the legendary tiger clan of Ranthambore National Park and their remarkable revival in northwestern India.

metas.name: Brenda
metas.description: In 1994 New Orleans (right before the internet), two married weed dealers face a dilemma when their five-year-old son overhears their code name for marijuana and tries to solve the mystery of his parents’ imaginary friend. The movie shares a name with the code word: BRENDA.

metas.name: The Boys and the Bees
metas.description: Traces a family’s journey toward freedom, nurturing their bees and their young sons amid Georgia’s shifting seasons while they learn to care for the land that sustains them.

metas.name: Through Your Eyes
metas.description: After a young woman passes away, her life is reflected through the memories of her friends and family. While processing her time on this earth, she desperately longs to reclaim her life.

metas.name: F8te
metas.description: A man who lets a Magic 8-Ball run his entire life must finally take charge

metas.name: Brothers Under Fire
metas.description: Captain Jordan Wright's squadron on leave for a wedding in Mexico encounters a murderous cartel. As Jordan tries to lead survivors to safety, war erupts between his squad and the cartel, forcing him into a battle to save his men.

metas.name: Roommates
metas.description: When shy college freshman Devon asks cool-girl Celeste to be her roommate, a blossoming friendship quickly spirals into a war of passive aggression.

metas.name: Changing Lanes
metas.description: Politics and planning collide in the struggle to redesign Brooklyn's notoriously dangerous McGuinness Blvd.

metas.name: Yuki Johnson - Detroit's Vigilante
metas.description: In racially divided Detroit, Yuki Johnson, a biracial teenager, transforms into the Detroit Vigilante after his father, a police officer, is targeted by a menacing gang.

metas.name: Return to the Moon
metas.description: A half-century after American astronauts walked on the Moon, NASA and its international partners are taking the dream of Apollo a giant step further. In the coming years, the Artemis missions – named after Apollo's twin sister in Greek mythology – aim to bring astronauts back to the Moon and establish a lunar space station for scientific and commercial exploration. Follow the four members of the Artemis II crew as they embark on a perilous 10-day journey to orbit the Moon, venturing beyond Earth orbit for the first time since Apollo and farther into the Solar System than any humans have gone before. And get an inside look at the preparations needed to overcome the extreme engineering challenges of human-crewed spaceflight, all the way from launch to splashdown.

metas.name: Don't Make Me Bless You
metas.description: Don't Make Me Bless You is a gripping urban drama about Raine, a salon owner who falls for Dre, a charming ex-con rebuilding his life after prison. a dangerous cycle of control and violence, forcing Raine to confront the truth about love.

metas.name: Providence
metas.description: Erica Schreiner short.

metas.name: Brad Wenzel: Desperate Times
metas.description: Full stand up special from comedy's own, Brad Wenzel.  Brad Wenzel is a product of the Detroit Comedy scene, spent a 7 year stint in Los Angeles, and over the last 15 years has toured the country performing in 38 states. Wenzel has made 3 stand-up appearances on CONAN and more recently performed on Netflix is a Joke Radio and Don't Tell Comedy. His 2017 debut comedy album Sweet Nothings was released on Jack White’s rock label, Third Man Records and can be heard on SiriusXM. Paste Magazine described Brad’s 2023 special, joke. joke. joke. as “Watching Wenzel feels like hanging out with your funniest, weirdest friend; it's relaxing and utterly enjoyable" Paste also listed joke. joke. joke. as one of the 20 best comedy specials of the year.

metas.name: In Passing
metas.description: Two young romantics, Maya and Alex, navigate life in the same city, their lives unfolding in parallel as they unknowingly cross paths again and again. As they each search for love in their own way, their near encounters hint at something more.

metas.name: My Other Half
metas.description: In this tense urban thriller, grief opens the door to danger as Mia becomes the target of a calculated scheme, forcing her to outplay her predators before they finish the job they started.

metas.name: CROSSED
metas.description: A young lady is seemingly going "crazy" while being tormented by and unknown source, when attempting to confide in her boyfriend and friends they slowly withdrawal from her "nonsense"

metas.name: Dragongate USA: The Gate Of Sin City
metas.description: High-speed technical wrestling and legendary tradition collide in the heart of the desert as Dragongate USA presents The Gate Of Sin City, a premier event held at the Horseshoe Las Vegas as part of The Collective 2026.

metas.name: PoderMania~! 2026
metas.description: The ‘Power of Lucha' ignites the Las Vegas Strip as PoderMania~! makes its high-octane debut as part of The Collective 2026. Streaming live on TrillerTV+, this afternoon spectacle at Horseshoe Las Vegas kicks off the Wednesday festivities of The Collective and TrillerTV's Mania Week.

metas.name: Mouthful of Soil
metas.description: Trees, Flowers, Hands and Mirrors. An exercise in movement and focus. Black & White, Silent.

metas.name: The Loud House: European Adventure
metas.description: The Louds are headed to Europe, where they'll attend a knighting ceremony in London, search for the world's best pizza in Italy, spend a night in a creepy castle in Transylvania, ski the Swiss alps, and time-travel to ancient Greece!

metas.name: The Bunny Mask
metas.description: The main character has a completely normal life, until one day a strange bunny mask appears on their bedside table. No matter what they do, this mask will not go away. The mask begins to deteriorate along with the main character's life.

metas.name: Trip Ziggurat
metas.description: A road trip to a Ziggurat in Colorado sparks connection between Arabs in the state. Filmmaker, Usama Alshaibi, embarks on a journey to the Crestone Ziggurat. His personal pilgrimage intertwines with the stories of other Arabs in Boulder who find ways of bringing their homelands to the state.

metas.name: MACAAN
metas.description: When a Somali immigrant joins an adult ESL class, he romantically pursues an uninterested classmate all while navigating the many challenges of the modern immigrant experience.

metas.name: The Ovvlog
metas.description: Documenting a group of thespians as they traverse NYC, visionary director Ovcharov takes the audience up close and personal as we see their triumphs... and their pitfalls.

metas.name: Dreams
metas.description: Plagued by stressful dreams and wrestling with grief, an anxious man reaches out for help from a—let’s say—nontraditional mental health provider.

metas.name: The Proctor
metas.description: A 56-year-old man stuck repeating senior year since 1986 gets one last shot at graduation when a new state exam system forces him to face the test he's spent decades avoiding.

metas.name: VAPE SHOW (1-3)
metas.description: A snapshot into the lives of several people living in small town Minnesota.

metas.name: The Black Bart of Taco King #17
metas.description: A suave larcenist searches for a new partner at a dive bar and finds the perfect Bonnie to his Clyde. He takes her to dinner to put her to the test, yet she has all the answers... and more.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: Two friends, Alex and Jordan, reflect on their past, one last time.

metas.name: Know Who You Are At Every Age
metas.description: An excerpt from a dream

metas.name: Balls Up
metas.description: Two marketing executives go "balls out" and pitch a bold full‑coverage condom sponsorship with the World Cup. After their drunken celebration in Brazil sparks a global scandal, they must outrun furious fans, criminals, and power-hungry officials to salvage their careers and make it home alive.

metas.name: Artemis: To the Moon and Back
metas.description: The inside story of the Artemis II mission - filmed over three and a half years at NASA. How did four astronauts travel to the moon, going deeper into space than ever before?

metas.name: Heard
metas.description: HEARD profiles Hard of Hearing (HoH) creatives across BC who use their hearing loss to further their practice as artists and creatives. Guided by HoH filmmaker Brian Ceci, the film visually explores the everyday lived experiences in a dramatic and comedic way, contextualizing for the audience what it's truly like to live with hearing loss.

metas.name: The Straight & Narrow
metas.description: A young man realizes that post-graduation life isn't all it's cracked up to be. As he struggles to adjust to the mundane nature of the 9-5, he questions life's true meaning and the value of a dollar over one's goals and dreams.

metas.name: The Happiest Time
metas.description: A man looks back on his childhood.

metas.name: Betting On A Dead Man
metas.description: Benny Grimm is a well-renowned mafia boss who runs the streets of Gilbert. But one night, everything changes.

metas.name: Delirium
metas.description: Jude, tormented by a relentless dream, has each night stolen by fear everyday consumed by exhaustion. His avoidance then search for understanding descends him into madness.

metas.name: Dual Citizen
metas.description: In 2012, the Haitian government amended the country’s constitution to allow dual citizenship. Filmmaker Rachelle Salnave is eager to reclaim her Haitian citizenship, but the process is far from simple: To do so, her father, Edouard, must reclaim his first before she can. Edouard, a New York Republican who has not set foot in Haiti in more than 50 years, reluctantly agrees to help his daughter, which means engaging with a country and government he has kept at arm’s length since his family’s political exile in the 1960s. This humorous and heartfelt documentary is both a father-daughter road trip and a meditation on what it means to hold two national identities.

metas.name: Capio
metas.description: An amateur astronomer discovers a strange new star in the sky that leads him into the heart of a dark conspiracy to control humanity by exploiting its addiction to technology.

metas.name: Tag! You’re It!
metas.description: One night in an art museum, Sunny and Pippin, two girls living inside of the paintings, play a game of tag spanning the history of human art.

metas.name: The Hollywood Rabbi
metas.description: How does the child of immigrants, raised on the Lower East Side of Manhattan, become Frank Sinatra’s personal rabbi, win two Academy Awards, mingle with four kings, three popes, eight presidents and a who’s who of Hollywood royalty while dedicating his life to healing the world through tolerance?

metas.name: Fly
metas.description: A queer coming-of-age romance about Skylar, a young Black ballet prodigy navigating the cost of perfection. A scholarship student at an elite ballet academy, Skylar channels fear and the weight of expectation into absolute discipline. When their mother falls behind on tuition, and the academy announces a paid professional apprenticeship, Skylar’s pursuit of excellence becomes a matter of survival. Their carefully controlled world is disrupted by Jay’ko, a gifted classmate whose free-spirited artistry contrasts sharply with Skylar’s precision. What begins as rivalry slowly deepens into intimacy, challenging Skylar’s belief that greatness comes from control alone. As the final audition approaches, Skylar must decide whether to cling to perfection or risk vulnerability in pursuit of artistic freedom.

metas.name: Birthday Boy
metas.description: Rae is an artist going through an identity crisis. They’re unsure of their gender, struggling to find success, and starting to feel a little invisible. Today is Rae’s birthday, and when their father Jeff comes to visit, along with his troubled wife Mandy, things start to deteriorate. Tragedy strikes the house within minutes, but Jeff insists that they stick to the birthday plan: a family meal at his favourite Mexican restaurant. As the day goes on, Rae fights to hold the family together, comfort their grieving partner Alice, keep an eye on the increasingly-drunken Mandy, and deal with the non-stop stress of Jeff’s personality, all while being ignored and misunderstood by everyone around them; until the tension bursts and they finally confront their father, with awkward results.

metas.name: A Homecoming
metas.description: Doug, a newly transitioning trans woman, has yet to take a new name. When she returns home with her pregnant partner for her parents’ 40th Anniversary, her mother unexpectedly struggles. Recognizing the fear behind the resistance, Doug extends to her mother an extraordinary gesture of grace.

metas.name: The Connection
metas.description: When three roommates discover their everyday items start going missing, they each try to figure out the source of the mystery.

metas.name: Lost In Thought
metas.description: After finding a photo of a girl in the pocket of a vintage Coat, Charlie introduces himself to the love of his life. As he dates the love of his life, Hope, he must decide whether a relationship with her is reality, or is it all in his head.

metas.name: COACH
metas.description: After receiving some tough news from her upset mother, Ellie gains a mentor in the midst of trouble.

metas.name: Copper Oxidizing
metas.description: The gradual transformation of copper through oxidation reflects the spirit of deconstruction, turning material change into a metaphor.

metas.name: The Climate Change Volumes: Fall
metas.description: Following the changing seasons of the Mountain West, The Climate Change Volumes: Fall ponders fall’s delay as warmer summers extend and keep this transitory season from occurring during its normal time on our calendars.

metas.name: what does it feel like to live inside of a pomegranate?
metas.description: A young woman discovers a giant pomegranate in the middle of the forest and decides to live inside it.

metas.name: Stay Until You Can’t
metas.description: Two women must navigate a growing relationship and a zombie outbreak that turned only straight people.

metas.name: Kenopsia
metas.description: After falling into the strange liminal world of her own canvas, struggling artist Alex must revisit her past and confront her fears in order to find her way home.  Inspired by liminal spaces and The Backrooms, Kenopsia was written to explore the phenomenon of liminality and what happens when we go through stages of liminal space in our real lives. Liminal space isn't just physical, we enter periods of liminality in our lives whenever we transition from one life stage to the next, e.g. graduation, coming of age/adolescence, breaking up, marriage, pregnancy, moving house, grief. Liminality is something we will all experience at some point or another in our lifetime, and as such it's important to know how to navigate and grow from the experience. After all, you wouldn't want to be stuck in limbo forever would you?

metas.name: Three Angles
metas.description: On the night before the Final Four, a rising college basketball star relives the same dream across shifting timelines. Trapped between past, present, and potential, he must overcome his deepest fear before it costs him everything. This non-linear psychological drama explores identity, trauma and the silent struggle with mental health in the athlete community.

metas.name: Dreaming Ecosystems
metas.description: A collaborative botanicollage film poem by participants in the festival workshop, Dreaming Ecosystems, led by poet Mita Mahato and filmmaker Caryn Cline.

metas.name: Joe Dombrowski: Dad on Arrival
metas.description: In his latest special, Joe Dombrowski steps into his biggest role yet...Dad.  Filmed live at Olsen Run Comedy Club in Eugene, Oregon, the hour captures Joe on the brink of fatherhood as he and his husband prepare for their first child, while realizing he may be wildly unprepared. With his signature sharp wit, Joe dives into the chaos of IVF, the shock of how little he knows about the female anatomy, and the trend of babies being given names better suited for retirement communities. He also hilariously tackles the question every gay couple hears: “So... who’s the dad?”

metas.name: Ruins Within Ruins
metas.description: A group of dancers positions themselves between the ancient and modern ruins of the island of Crete, Greece.

metas.name: Grandpa's Graveyard
metas.description: After the death of his father, a young TV writer must face his family’s trauma head on with the help of his new assistant, Gary the Horse.

metas.name: Coming Back Home
metas.description: A short documentary that reveals the background to the historic restoration of Money from Home.

metas.name: NOTHING WILL COME OF NOTHING
metas.description: Nurture, nature, voicemails, photographs.

metas.name: 12 Angry Men
metas.description: A juror attempts to convince the other 11 jurors to question the guilt of a 16 year old boy accused of killing his father.

metas.name: Caught in the Crackdown
metas.description: FRONTLINE and ProPublica trace the violence, protests and arrests stemming from federal immigration sweeps across the United States. The documentary examines the tactics, legal cases and impact — from Los Angeles to Chicago to Minneapolis.

metas.name: The Story of the Cricket Queen
metas.description: The “Story of The Cricket Queen” recreates digital media tropes, trends, and aesthetics with analog film techniques.

metas.name: Vaivén
metas.description: Vaivén follows three generations of beachgoers from sunrise to sunset in Barcelona - a study of patterns, rhythm, and the natural cadence of a day at the beach.

metas.name: Modern Art
metas.description: A withdrawn security guard drifts through life until an encounter with an artist sparks a quiet awakening, leading him to begin exploring where his own sense of art might lie.

metas.name: The Birthday Gift
metas.description: In this playful, cross cultural family drama, an unexpected guest upends the lives of an Argentine mother and daughter over the course of an intimate birthday dinner one icy Chicago night.

metas.name: Florence is for Lovers
metas.description: A fragmented encounter on a Tuscan train leads to an unsettling meditation on intimacy, violence, and communication in this part-travelogue, part-city symphony.

metas.name: Untold: Jail Blazers
metas.description: Volatile players. Criminal charges. National headlines. Portland's championship-caliber NBA team implodes spectacularly in this unflinching documentary.

metas.name: Special Op: Rent-a-Cop
metas.description: After falling in love and leaving Special Ops, special agent Brock Belfry finds himself working security in a small town and ends up escorting a van full of senior citizens to Las Vegas for their summer trip. But the trip will not go smoothly as he realizes that his archenemies have tracked him down and plot to take him out.

metas.name: HVAC
metas.description: In a blue-collar Missouri town, a 13-year-old HVAC apprentice grappling with confusing desires becomes entangled in a surreal, dangerous encounter at the local theatre—where longing and innocence bleed together in one irreversible night.

metas.name: First Date Conversations
metas.description: Zoe and Scott's first date is upended when she receives a difficult phone call about her estranged father. As the two delve into questions of morality, family, and conviction, the night becomes a self examination of choices and old wounds.

metas.name: The Highest Stakes
metas.description: Five strangers are invited to a luxurious hotel for a high-stakes poker game. What begins as a contest for fortune quickly spirals into something far more dangerous. As tensions rise and secrets surface, the players realize the stakes aren’t just about money—they’re about survival. In a night of escalating peril, trust becomes a weapon, and every choice could seal their fate.

metas.name: Once a Week for Life
metas.description: NYPD Lt. Adam Galanis leads the Fugitive Task Force as he tumbles through a merciless life while balancing on a razors edge. Adam fights personal demons and addictions when he's forced to take revenge on plotting traitors and the mafia who are trying to kill him.

metas.name: Hansel and Gretel
metas.description: A comedic music take on the classic Grimm’s fairytale.

metas.name: Trevor Noah: Joy in the Trenches
metas.description: From unexpected social media beef to a therapist's truth bomb, Trevor Noah turns chaos into comedy in this hilariously sharp, playful stand-up set.

metas.name: Hearts
metas.description: A mob boss casino owner and his apprehensive daughter have a deadly conversation over a game of Hearts in this student produced 1920s drama.

metas.name: Blue Girl
metas.description: A queer coming of age film, that follows a girl named Olivia as she struggles to hide her relationship from her mother Carrie.

metas.name: Double-Edged Dagger
metas.description: A 1-minute short animation about “time for a change,” where a dagger becomes a symbol of transformation, shifting from a tool of violence into something meaningful for someone you care about. As time passes, the story unfolds through changing seasons, evolving aspect ratios, and shifting colour and tone, transitioning from a sense of mystery into a more emotional and dramatic narrative.

metas.name: Hope
metas.description: Narrated by Javi, the only family member able to cross the border, Hope revisits his parents' migration story and the difficult reality that keeps them from returning home.

metas.name: Treasure Reboot
metas.description: Lincoln and his friends go on an adventure to find his grandpas hidden treasure.

metas.name: Queer Blue Sky
metas.description: After realizing many of the best parts of their relationship were maybe kind of queer, Beth and Chris decide to break up in a queer way too.

metas.name: Hand
metas.description: Trapped between duty and despair, an undocumented Chinese cook begins to question the cost of survival in a country that sees him as invisible as anti-Asian aggression rises outside his kitchen walls.

metas.name: For You
metas.description: Jordan (Demarcus Jackson) enters a time loop after a masked man breaks into his house, sending him on a trip backwards in time.

metas.name: Sudden Death
metas.description: Obsessive film professor Charlie is one long-take away from realizing his magnum opus film, SUDDEN DEATH. As problems spring up left and right, Charlie begins to put into question his legitmacy as a director and person.

metas.name: Bite marks
metas.description: Short poetry film showcasing the difficulties of growing up.

metas.name: Brandie Posey - Milk Job
metas.description: Brandie Posey's debut comedy special

metas.name: The canticles of a ghost,
metas.description: In a single, unbroken drift through the night, a solitary figure moves between fragments of life—intimacy, conflict, and celebration—never quite entering any of them.

metas.name: Five Stages Until
metas.description: When her husband chooses to stop treatment, a grieving woman leans on dance to survive the silence, while her daughter struggles to bridge the gulf between denial and acceptance.

metas.name: The Last Hand
metas.description: Down on his luck, a single father stumbles into a casino in hopes of winning big to support his daughter. Things take a dark turn when he follows a mysterious dealer deeper into the casino...

metas.name: Baby Cigarette
metas.description: for anyone who's ever been a baby... or a cigarette

metas.name: Forgive You
metas.description: Since the death of his wife, Marla, Henry just can’t seem to find life funny anymore. And yet, he must come to terms with the reality of a life even God himself seems to be laughing at.

metas.name: Sympathy
metas.description: A man tries to come to terms with a crime he committed

metas.name: the road where i go to die
metas.description: A short abstract visual poem of a film about the grief a guy experiences driving through the road his best friend lived on before committing suicide.

metas.name: The Forest of Oscar Geppetto
metas.description: A further exploration of how Oscar Geppetto views music and reality. A sequence cut from the original film.

metas.name: shoemotion
metas.description: comprised of over 1600 photos, this short films follows a converse on an adventure

metas.name: If You Really Love Me, Outlive Me
metas.description: The colourful life of Texas honky-tonk hero Dale Watson and his wife, Celine Lee - a Miami-born ex-playboy bunny turned singer. Stars of their very own southern fairytale, Dale and Celine formed a magnetic bond that went beyond their love for the rockabilly scene and inserted itself into the mic between them, launching a life of lyrical adventure. Across a landscape where Americana roots defy commercial trends and keep the soul of country music alive, we travel with the electric duo from Texas dancehalls to Memphis landmarks, meeting the characters and communities that shape their unapologetically free life.

metas.name: Riding the Rails with Geoffrey Baer
metas.description: For generations, seemingly all paths led through Chicago as trains carrying passengers, livestock, and freight crisscrossed the country. In a new WTTW special and companion website, Riding the Rails, lifelong train enthusiast Geoffrey Baer hops aboard all kinds of trains to tell the story of this essential mode of transport and how it shaped our city. Along the way, he uncovers clues all around us to railroads of the past, recalls the colorful characters who built them and the unsung workers who toiled on them, and reveals why our current rail system is just as vital to Chicago’s existence today.

metas.name: The Falicornia Institute of the Rats
metas.description: Four ambitious acting students hone their crafts at the prestigious Falicornia Institute of the Rats.

metas.name: The Clock Maker
metas.description: Upon the glade, the Clock Maker confronts the Time Thief after hunting him for a very long time.

metas.name: The Heartbreak Kid: Becoming Shawn Michaels
metas.description: Follows the life and career of WWE performer Shawn Michaels, tracing his rise, personal struggles, and eventual comeback with an unfiltered look at his journey.

metas.name: Stay for the Q&A
metas.description: Following a feature film premiere, at a prestigious film festival, a routine Q&A devolves into a familiar and unhinged experience.

metas.name: Hungy Ghost
metas.description: 'Hungy Ghost' is an emotionally unhinged comedy set in Earth's last botanical garden starring a ghost who is prone to bouts of world-destroying imposter syndrome every time he tries to prove his worth to others.

metas.name: Clean Slate
metas.description: A woman confesses her biggest secret to the man she loves at the most inopportune time.

metas.name: Embrace
metas.description: When a bar bathroom hookup takes an otherworldly turn, two men must work through their problems to move forward.

metas.name: Loss
metas.description: Amy is having the worst day of her life. Her 16-year-old daughter, Emma, is finally undergoing a heart transplant after waiting over two years. As Emma fights for her life, Amy sits alone in the hospital waiting room, overwhelmed by fear, exhaustion, and a deep anger towards God. She tries to pray but can’t find the words, consumed by rage at the unfairness of it all.

metas.name: Wasteland Cop
metas.description: After avenging the death of his family, an ex-soldier wanders through a post-apocalyptic landscape fending off nomadic tribes that prey upon outsiders. During his travels he meets an odd group of survivors, who convince him to become the law in a land where there is no law.

metas.name: Henry
metas.description: Montana and Henry have broken up, but now it's October and they are trying something new.

metas.name: A Royal Romance in Ibiza
metas.description: After a painful breakup with her ex-business partner, Dylan Harper, a talented American developer, is determined to prove herself on her next big contract - creating a luxury wellness hotel for His Royal Highness King Edward on the breathtaking island of Ibiza. The opportunity is a dream come true for Dylan - until she comes face to face with the king's son, Prince Nicholas, a dashing bachelor with his own ideas on how to execute the hotel project.

metas.name: Boris Is Dead
metas.description: A struggling actor, working as a waiter, unwittingly becomes involved in a violent heist gone wrong, where his boss—deep in debt—has been stealing from employees and running the restaurant as a front for the mob.

metas.name: Slowburn Shoot: An Indie Wrestling Story
metas.description: Documentary that goes behind the curtain, exploring the intimate relationships and untold stories that shape the pro wrestling industry.

metas.name: Deep in My Heart is a Song
metas.description: An aging country musician who's struggling to make ends meet receives an offer for an unusual private gig. Based on the life of cowboy singer Johnny Bencomo, who plays himself in the film.

metas.name: Noah Kahan: Out of Body
metas.description: After rocketing to global fame, singer-songwriter Noah Kahan returns to his Vermont roots to get back in tune with himself.

metas.name: The BREAK-IN
metas.description: A man breaks into an apartment, only to discover that the owner is broke.

metas.name: The Patchwright
metas.description: In the sprawling slag heaps of NiiroCradle, a fugitive android visits the Patchwright, an unlicensed body mechanic, begging him to trace a fragment of a childhood memory.

metas.name: Our Song
metas.description: Through the highs and lows of life, Hank and Sarah's love story is forever tied to their special song. What begins as a tune that sparked their love becomes a bittersweet echo of what was. Some songs never end - even when love does.

metas.name: So Glad We Never Met
metas.description: Cheeto dust is just the surface of this dark satire... while the name Bentin Barantino may seem familiar to you, Flossie, a young female film student, knows him all too well.

metas.name: This Is Private
metas.description: A stripper cunningly decides to use her private dances as therapy sessions in order to prevail in her collegiate psychology class.

metas.name: Jaylah
metas.description: After receiving a text from her crush, a naive 17-year-old must choose between looking after her grandmother and losing her virginity.

metas.name: The Despicable Speeder-Man
metas.description: A masked vigilante saves the day, and nothing bad ever happens.

metas.name: Brad Williams: Live on Short Street
metas.description: Brad Williams is back with his fourth stand-up comedy special LIVE ON SHORT STREET!  A fearless, high-energy hour packed with outrageous true stories, brutally honest observations, and nonstop laughs from one of the most electrifying comedians in the world.  Filmed live in front of a sold-out crowd in Lexington, KY, Brad dives into everything from relationships, marriage, and fatherhood to disability, sex, therapy, and the absurd realities of modern life. With razor-sharp punchlines and explosive storytelling, this special proves why Brad continues to sell out theaters around the globe.

metas.name: Paid For
metas.description: A woman pays for an hour in a hotel room, but not for what you’d expect. What unfolds between two sisters is a confrontation neither of them is ready for.

metas.name: Johnny Bronson
metas.description: A rage-bait streamer is reached out to by next-door neighbor, forcing him to confront his views on humanity. Also he's an alien from outer space sent to get humanity to destroy itself, so conflict is inevitable.

metas.name: Low on Fuel
metas.description: A tumultuous meeting between supposed friends leads Mike on a path of self discovery that lands him in the wrong place at the wrong time.

metas.name: The Grossfarken and the Boy
metas.description: Despite stories of a monster upstream, a young village boy ventures into the creek and discovers the truth behind his town's lore.

metas.name: Structural Changes
metas.description: A camera moves through the architecture of the renowned private art school, California Institute of the Arts, while a man touches up paint on the neglected exterior. Somewhere inside, the upper administration drafts increasingly dire emails to send to its faculty and staff.

metas.name: Exquisite Corpse
metas.description: Inspired by the surrealist game of "exquisite corpse," the film pieces together the story of a Harris mud crab who is a new species in the waters of the Baltic Sea since 2011. The film unfolds a layered story of "invasive species," disrupted ecosystems, and the questions they raise about human values in a world of constant environmental flux.

metas.name: Chew This!
metas.description: Influenced by Yoko Ono's 1964 performance "Cut Piece," the film is an explosion of energy, anger, and spirit that explores sexual exploitation and violence against female/femme bodies. Short, fast, and sweet like an angry spitfire punk song, blink and you'll miss the show!

metas.name: My Structuralist Film
metas.description: How shall I cater best to your desire for me to be visible? Set up as a confessional-cum-guided meditation, My Structuralist Film uses performance artist Tehching Hsieh's One Year Performance (“Time Clock Piece”) as a framework to illustrate the filmmaker's (presumable) insides. How thoroughly should a trans body want or need to be visible? On what terms is the filmmaker obligated to narrativize, perform, or even fabricate visibility for the sake of an audience? Considering the limits and limitations of disclosure, this project positions the act of looking not as an offering or an exchange, but as an unyielding neoliberal, capitalist thirst to consume.

metas.name: A is for Apple
metas.description: A semantically unstable encounter with objects, images, and words.

metas.name: I Feel At Peace Thinking Of Today
metas.description: After going through a painful period, ceramicist Heloisa Guedes underwent a transformation that came from the inside out. She left behind the hectic pace of the city for a new life in São Luiz do Paraitinga, in search of a reconnection with her own needs. Little by little, she began to live in alignment with what felt meaningful to her: self-care, artistic expression and being close to nature.

metas.name: The Following Day
metas.description: It's a sweltering summer in New York. Morgan, a soft-spoken young woman prone to daydreaming, finds refuge inside the cinema where the boundaries between fantasy and reality blur, on screen and off.

metas.name: Betty St. Clair
metas.description: When an anxious Chinese American drag queen hosts an all-AAPI showcase for an unconventional audience, a surprise guest sends her spiraling into self-doubt. Meanwhile, backstage shenanigans from her chaotic drag family threaten to derail the whole show.

metas.name: Kit
metas.description: A teenager with dwarfism is hidden away from an unforgiving world by his superficial mother but discovers that his talent for drawing can set him free.

metas.name: Cleaned Out
metas.description: In this twisty comedy, a maid who works for a mob boss must stand up for herself when he refuses to pay the money he owes her.

metas.name: The Eye
metas.description: In this sly comic zinger from Director Deanne Bray, a hearing Hollywood casting agent is having no luck casting a Deaf role authentically. When an actor named Frank (played by John Maucere) walks in, however, the casting agent gets more than she bargained for.

metas.name: MAINTAINED
metas.description: A maintenance worker goes deep into an overgrown forest to inspect an abandoned watchtower site. As he dutifully records his findings, he is surprised when the forest seems to start sending him messages.

metas.name: Fluent
metas.description: A quirky new hearing employee joins a Deaf-owned business and quickly begins to drive her boss crazy.

metas.name: Medal Chase
metas.description: Meet Rudolfs Stupans, one of the top Deaf competitive swimmers in the world. This exhilarating film follows Rudolfs as he gives us a glimpse of his training routine and what drives him to push forward to the top of his game.

metas.name: From Invisible To Invincible
metas.description: This upbeat self-portrait chronicles the personal journey of Donald M. Falls. Born Deaf and raised without adequate support, Donald transforms into a confident young man with pride and purpose.

metas.name: The Power of Goodbye
metas.description: Margot is a woman whose health is slowly degenerating from ALS. When she asks her mother Christiane to help her end her life on her own terms with dignity, Christiane is forced to confront a profound challenge to her maternal love.

metas.name: Wait and Remain
metas.description: Eddie Reyes wakes in an unfamiliar room with no memory of how he got there. Guided by an unnerving presence, he's drawn through fragments of his life in a space that defies explanation. As reality fractures, Eddie must face who he's been, and who he might become.

metas.name: Scout’s Honor
metas.description: Desperate to attend the concert of their dreams before heading off to college, two friends join the legions of a fake girl scout troop in hopes of earning the money in time.

metas.name: The Axe Forgets
metas.description: Inspired by a true a story. In 1888 James S. Jameson, heir to the Jameson Whiskey dynasty, returns to Ireland after a year long expedition to the Congo. Things start to unravel as he attempts a return to normality. Will he choose to face the truth? Or will he choose the axe once more?

metas.name: Unfinished Work
metas.description: Eric Chavez has a heart of gold, a magnetic personality, and a knack for telling stories–but the young artist and his vibrant family are haunted by the shadow of a past tragedy in this dreamlike, observational documentary that was filmed over 12 years.

metas.name: MLW & NJPW Present CMLL Fantastica Mania USA 2026
metas.description: Fantastica Mania USA 2026 was a professional event co-produced by American promotion Major League Wrestling (MLW), Japanese promotion New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) and Mexican promotion Consejo Mundial De Lucha Libre (CMLL) that took place on April 12, 2026 at Festival Hall in Charleston, South Carolina, USA.

metas.name: Vermilion
metas.description: Haunted by the memory of his mother's death and suffocated by his father's controlling grip, an obsessive painter ventures to the brink of madness in his pursuit of artistic perfection.

metas.name: Ten Thousand Reasons for Revenge
metas.description: After a struggling single mom's daughter takes money from a dying bank robber, the two become entangled in a tense investigation that threatens everything they love.

metas.name: After Words
metas.description: An ambitious actress and a disillusioned writer meet by chance, igniting a fragile romance that forces them to confront jealousy, insecurity, and the sacrifices love demands.

metas.name: AEW Dynasty 2026
metas.description: Dynasty 2026 was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on April 12, 2026, at Rogers Arena in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. The show was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Kenny Omega for the AEW World Championship, dubbed "The Devil vs. The God of Pro Wrestling."

metas.name: Jerry the Ginger Eater
metas.description: A man who eats red-headed women befriends a sex worker in hopes to eat her red-headed lady pimp.

metas.name: Legends of the Lost Ark
metas.description: Chronicles archaeologist Dr. Chris McKinny’s search for the Ark of the Covenant. Supported by insights from scientists, historians, and biblical scholars, he explores three ancient legends pointing to final resting place of the iconic relic.

metas.name: Winter Hymns
metas.description: A palliative care doctor meets with a series of dying patients.

metas.name: Private Browser
metas.description: Jane questions her boyfriend's attraction to her after seeing porn on his phone.

metas.name: Hollis
metas.description: After leaving New York City behind, Hollis checks into a quiet roadside motel where she meets Adam, a young male escort she’s hired—not for sex, but for something stranger. As the night unfolds, Hollis guides Adam through an unsettling, intimate experiment that blurs emotional and psychological boundaries. But just as she returns to her routine, a sudden, senseless act of violence shatters the illusion of control she tried to reclaim.

metas.name: Nelly Knows Mysteries: All Manners of Murder
metas.description: Nelly and Detective Michael set out to solve the  murder of a guest while at a lavish dinner.

metas.name: Swim Sistas
metas.description: Swim Sistas follows the swimming journeys of three very different Black girls/women as barriers are broken down in the water.

metas.name: THE EDGE
metas.description: As tensions erupt worldwide, three black men retreat for a weekend of healing, meditation, and connection.

metas.name: The HOA will not be Happy about This
metas.description: A door to door salesman knocks on the door of an unsuspecting client. But who needs more from the other?

metas.name: Shift
metas.description: A self-conscious teenage girl will do anything to look perfect. When she begins injecting herself with a mysterious cosmetic drug, her body soon takes a monstrous turn.

metas.name: Love Letter to Texas
metas.description: A cinematic tribute to the spirit and landscape of Texas, following a lone character who travels across its vast terrain in search of a life that better fits who he is.

metas.name: Soothing Family Landscapes
metas.description: A family live stream is repeatedly interrupted by its own sponsor's inappropriate marketing.

metas.name: Mike & Nick & Nick & Alice
metas.description: Two gangsters and the woman they love try to survive the most dangerous night of their lives. As if that wasn’t enough, there’s one wild ingredient added to the mix: a time machine.

metas.name: Secret Sins
metas.description: After the death of his father, a pastor's son takes the lead, but a power-hungry deacon plots his ruin in a tale of faith, ambition, and betrayal.

metas.name: How to Make a Killing
metas.description: Disowned at birth by his obscenely wealthy family, blue-collar Becket Redfellow will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance, no matter how many relatives stand in his way.

metas.name: Southside Kev
metas.description: South-Side Kev follows a misguided teenager as he navigates the mean streets of South Jamaica Queens, struggling to find the balance between earning respect and maintaining his innocence.

metas.name: Pageant Panic
metas.description: At a local pageant, two determined contestants let their rivalry get out of hand while an overwhelmed assistant attempts to maintain order.

metas.name: KILLAS
metas.description: This documentary offers an intimate look at a recreational basketball team competing in a local league over the course of a single season. Filmed and created by one of the team’s own players, the project blends on-court action with candid moments off the court, capturing game footage, locker-room conversations, and personal reflections from the athletes themselves.

metas.name: Gangster’s Daughter 5
metas.description: After a crushing loss, Kadisha cannot grieve before a new threat emerges, turning friends into foes in a world where nothing is as it seems.

metas.name: 4.7 Seconds: For the Championship
metas.description: The greatest title game ending in the history of March Madness

metas.name: Chris Parker: Stop Being So Dramatic
metas.description: Chris Parker explores the intense relationship with intrusive thoughts and memories of a dramatic childhood in community theater.

metas.name: Storm Warning
metas.description: MADE IN USA MARCH 15, 2026

metas.name: Investigating the Supernatural: Angels & Demons
metas.description: Investigative journalist Billy Hallowell travels across America to uncover the evidence for the spiritual realm, angels, and demons.

metas.name: Last Save Point
metas.description: In a scorched, post-apocalyptic world, survival is fragile and trust is dangerous. When a hardened loner discovers a naive man with the mind of a child, the two form an uneasy alliance, their journey colliding with a sinister school where the once students (now adults) are still ruled by the authority figures of the past. Fear, secrets, and the threats prevent them from exploring whats beyond their gated community.

metas.name: The Road to Tehran
