metas.description: The Road to Tehran is a short documentary looking at the US' strategy in Iran, the economic and political constraints which have shaped it and the inevitability of the war's spread. In doing so it shows how the US' assault on Venezuela, Cuba, Greenland and Iran are inexorably linked.

metas.name: People Magazine Investigates: The Secrets of the Twelve Tribes Cult
metas.description: Gene Spriggs forms the Twelve Tribes in Tennessee with teens and disenchanted hippies; the group later gains a cult reputation and faces accusations of child abuse, forced labor, and strict devotion to what members say is God's will.

metas.name: Tara Yummy's: Mindset Tour Documentary 2026
metas.description: A documentary of Tara Yummy's Mindset tour across the USA and Vancouver

metas.name: Madwoman's Game
metas.description: Follows the journey of a young Latina chess enthusiast, Bianca Mitchell-Avila, as she explores life's lessons through the lens of the game.

metas.name: The Last Street Interview
metas.description: Two TikTokers attempt to film a series of street interviews when a chance encounter changes the course of their lives forever.

metas.name: The Power of Pickleball
metas.description: "The Power of Pickleball" tells the story of a humble game that spread into a cultural phenomenon by bringing people together across generations, backgrounds, and walks of life. Centered on the passionate individuals who helped build the sport from the ground up, the film celebrates pickleball's unique ability to create community, spark joy, and change lives in unexpected ways.

metas.name: Ain't No Party
metas.description: A guy attempts to stop his best friend from making a huge mistake.

metas.name: The Plastic Detox
metas.description: This eye-opening documentary follows six couples with unexplained infertility as they lower their exposure to plastics in hopes it helps them conceive.

metas.name: Basic

Gloria then spirals through Nick’s past dating history, untangling his web of ex-girlfriends until she discovers the reason for all their issues: Kaylinn, the hottest, most basic ex-girlfriend to ever exist, who not only just took Gloria’s boyfriend, but is about to take her entire story from her, too. metas.name: The Pirate King
metas.description: A Marine veteran struggling with PTSD and addiction finds unexpected redemption when he joins a group of pirate reenactors, giving him a chance to fight for custody of his daughter and rebuild the life he thought was lost forever.

metas.name: Love Language
metas.description: Following a failed engagement, Lou discovers she has a talent for writing other people’s wedding vows. Word spreads across Chicago’s wedding scene and Lou’s services are in high demand. She even has a new admirer in Dash. But everything changes when she’s asked to write vows for Olivia, who’s marrying Warren, Lou’s old college flame.

Once a street kid, he’s now living the good life in L.A., engaged to his dream girl and working for her father’s real estate firm. But when he gets a text saying his brother overdosed, the promise he made to never return home shatters, pulling him back into the world he thought he’d escaped.

metas.name: Sapling
metas.description: A grieving mother returns to the cursed woodland where her son vanished, forcing her abusive husband to face the monstrous consequence of the violence he left behind.

metas.name: Famous
metas.description: A young woman desperate for social media fame exploits her father's death to go viral. But the volatile world of internet stardom pushes her to the edge. Famous explores how our craving for validation clashes with the false promises and distorted reality of social media.

metas.name: Reversion
metas.description: A man's brain is shrinking.

metas.name: Anywhere but Here as Long as I Don't Have to Leave the Comfort of Home
metas.description: A man travels out of town to visit a friend.

metas.name: Fargo Theatre: The First 100 Years
metas.description: In celebration of the Theatre’s centennial, we take a look back at the first hundred years of movies, pipe organs, concerts, festivals, popcorn, architecture, smoking lounges, and, very briefly, farm animals.

metas.name: Heartbreakers
metas.description: A heartbroken Adam Smith, unable to get over his ex-girlfriend, turns to Will Harvard and The Breaker Twins to get her back. Adam quickly discovers that they view love in a very different way than most.

metas.name: Mary the Widow
metas.description: An aging widow begrudgingly goes to a speed-dating event at her daughter’s request. Among a string of dud dates, one gentle stranger lingers in her mind. Mary the Widow is a tender look at love, memory, and the echoes of what we’ve lost.

metas.name: The Seemingly Perfect Family
metas.description: Inspired by true events. When 18-year-old Lexi ages out of the foster care system and lies to get an au pair job, the dream family she is working for turns out to be a nightmare as she uncovers their twisted secrets. Rylee Reagan stars.

metas.name: No Room For Love
metas.description: The Santiagos are a Filipino-American family of seven crammed into one tiny Los Angeles apartment, all chasing distant showbiz dreams. Bound by love and constant bickering, they navigate a turbulent year: isolation in spring, betrayal in summer, disaster at a fall party, and eviction in winter. No Room For Love is a comedy about big dreams, small spaces, and artists doing their best to survive poverty, bad luck, and each other - without ever giving up.

metas.name: Japantown: What is Lost, What Remains
metas.description: A man fights to preserve what remains of Salt Lake City’s erased Japantown.

metas.name: The Way We Move
metas.description: Amber Galloway, a trailblazer in ASL interpretation, takes us on a journey into the deep bond between the Deaf world and music. We follow her as she teaches struggling recruits who she hopes will have what it takes to join her at ACL music festival.

metas.name: The 13th Annual On Cinema Oscar Special
metas.description: Host and HEI Network CEO New Heidecker has sworn his departure from On Cinema at the Cinema, but frequent Guest Expert Gregg Turkington wants the show to go on... Will this be the last Oscar Special ever? Only one way to find out!

metas.name: Road To L'Etape Du Tour
metas.description: Facing a turning point in her life, a woman with a congenital heart defect embarks on a journey to train for a stage of the Tour de France.

metas.name: 40 Years of Fuckin' Up
metas.description: The Truth Behind The Insanity of The Iconic Punk Band NOFX

metas.name: AEW Revolution 2026
metas.description: The 2026 Revolution was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on March 15, 2026, at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Adam Page in a Texas Death Match for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Party USA
metas.description: When Taylor can't get her party store shift covered after her dad dies, she makes a deadly mistake that sparks a downward spiral of red, white and blue-collared chaos.

metas.name: Give It Up
metas.description: When washed up stand-up comedian Mortimer Baldwin (Gareth Reynolds) is replaced on his popular podcast by a viral sensation 9-year-old, his manager (Jake Johnson) sends him out on a tour to reclaim his career and film his comeback comedy special - but what's so funny?

metas.name: Young Female Playwright
metas.description: When 26-year-old Millie lands a career-making debut as playwright at Canada’s National Theatre, celebration quickly turns to scrutiny after a press release describes her play as a “deeply personal story”. Millie is sure that the dark, family-drama is a work of fiction; but her family is concerned, especially her Uncle Mark, a school teacher and recovered alcoholic. Through bright lights, and dark comedy, Young Female Playwright asks who gets to tell what story, and what it costs for a woman to be believed.

metas.name: The Fox
metas.description: An affable hunter encounters a shape-shifting fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his partner into the perfect woman and in doing so take control of the natural world.

metas.name: The Boy with the Dinosaur Head
metas.description: A troubled first-grader is convinced he's a dinosaur, much to the chagrin of the teacher tasked with bringing him back down to earth. What passes between them, though fragile and brief, is enough to change how both will remember this day.

metas.name: The Shepherd Code: Lapierre
metas.description: Lewis enlists his top agent, Alex Lapierre - aka "The Shepherd" - for a mission that's as high-stakes as it is dangerous: eliminate a list of targets for Tania Edwards, a powerful and enigmatic woman tangled in a massive scandal. But things quickly take an unexpected turn. A mysterious bounty hunter, known only as "The Ghost," enters the picture with a very different agenda: to take out both Tania and Alex, but on whose behalf? Caught between the conflicting demands of his superiors and his own growing doubts, Alex faces a tough decision: follow orders and remain the loyal soldier he's trained to be, or be swayed by Tania's allure and question everything he believes in.

metas.name: In a Few Words
metas.description: A man's cure for loneliness lies at the other end of an automated answering service.

metas.name: A Woman Commutes Home
metas.description: A woman commutes back home after having a traumatic night.

metas.name: Comedy Family Style
metas.description: In Comedy Family Style, stand-up comic Helen brings her son to Beijing to connect with their roots. He wants Wi-Fi and boba—she wants gratitude. Between culture clashes and punchlines, they confront the gap between love and perception, asking: How do we know we matter to the people we love.

metas.name: The Perfectionist
metas.description: A man spends so long trying to get his tie perfect that he misses the very meeting he was dressing for.

metas.name: Birth Is for P*ssies
metas.description: A rookie doula is thrust into her first birth with a mother she's never met. After a rocky start, she quickly learns supporting women through labor is messier, funnier, and more profound than any training could have prepared her for.

metas.name: Billiards
metas.description: John John, and Seth play an intense game of billiards where the winner takes it all

metas.name: AAA Rey De Reyes 2026
metas.description: The first match was Flammer's open challenge for the AAA Reina de Reinas Championship, which was answered by Bayley from WWE's Raw brand. The Rey de Reyes tournament final featuring "The Original" El Grande Americano, El Grande Americano, La Parka, and Santos Escobar followed. Next, Domink Mysterio defended the AAA Mega Championship against El Hijo Del Vikingo in a Lucha de Apuestas No Disqualification match.

metas.name: Confession
metas.description: A man driven to crime by economic turmoil, must confront his actions after violence escalates.

metas.name: Study Session
metas.description: When three students find the answers to the final exam they struggle to study for they enter a Mexican standoff to hopefully pass the test

metas.name: What a Guy Wants
metas.description: The CEO of a company that offers dating advice meets his match when a new client appears on the scene.

metas.name: Mystery Wrestling #22
metas.description: Mystery Wrestling #22 took place on Twitch,TV on March 14 2026

metas.name: In the Beginning
metas.description: A spaceprobe called Beresheet, legless birds of paradise, hamster cull and humanity trying to make the world make sense.

metas.name: Physical Touch
metas.description: When his wife is kidnapped by his ex-best friend, agent Dixon Butts must face his twisted nemesis in a deadly dance of fists, feelings, and frosting.

metas.name: How to Catch a Butterfly
metas.description: In 2021, 21-year-old Robert Aaron Long kills 6 Asian women in massage parlors in Atlanta, Georgia as a way to suppress his uncontrollable sexual desire. Dutch-Japanese filmmaker Kiriko Mechanicus writes letters to the young murderer to find out what his killings have to do with her sexual life. What do our racial fetishes tell us about our hidden human desires?

metas.name: Snooze
metas.description: After snoozing his alarm, a teenager drifts back into sleep, descending through a maze of time and reality. As the dream deepens, the line between the waking world and the sleeping specter begins to bleed and blur, until reality melts into a trance.

metas.name: Journeys of a Gentle Southern Man
metas.description: An animated hybrid documentary detailing the life of author Jackie K. Cooper.

metas.name: The Boy with My Son's Face
metas.description: Susan's baby dies, and she is convicted for a crime she doesn’t even remember committing. Years later, out on parole and fighting to start over, Susan sees a photograph that stops her cold.

metas.name: Marked By The Walk
metas.description: An aspiring model overcoming her anxiety in order to perform on the runway.

metas.name: Woodstockers
metas.description: When his marriage collapses and his best friend dies, an aging hippie who went to Woodstock in 1969 and never left must finally reckon with a life shaped by peace, love, and too much weed.

metas.name: The Liars of Black Mountain Road
metas.description: When a couple runs over a stranger's dog, they compete for the moral high ground at any cost.

metas.name: He's Out There
metas.description: Years ago, Devin, who has special needs, became enthralled by Bigfoot after watching the long-running reality TV series Mountain Monsters. When his mom took the opportunity to foster her son’s passion, daily hunts for Sasquatch grew into something more than a pastime. He’s Out There tells the story of—in Devin’s words—the proudest week of his life.

metas.name: Tell Me When You Get Home
metas.description: Fifteen year-old Honest Cardamom hasn’t seen her mother since she was four, but at a crowded family party she begins to feel her presence in ways she can’t explain. When Honest senses the presence of her mother she finds the courage to ask her uncle about the woman she barely remembers and, in doing so, begins to uncover pieces of herself.  Set in the space between Honest and her Uncle O, Tell Me When You Get Home unfolds as a long conversation between two people who have both lost a loved one. This short animated film is a testament to love and a testament to family.

metas.name: Divorce Resort
metas.description: After 8 years separated in the Philippines where divorce is illegal, Butch Meily, 72, travels to Guam for a quick divorce through residency laws. During his week-long stay, he reflects on his marriage while awaiting the final papers.

metas.name: A New Inferno
metas.description: Filmed during the hottest days of Phoenix, Arizona’s summer heatwave, A New Inferno follows paramedics as they race to save the lives of heatstroke victims using a radical new treatment: ice immersion therapy.

metas.name: In the Morning Sun
metas.description: In a quiet Toronto apartment, an immigrant mother finds comfort in her Alexa—weather updates, love songs, and the time back home become a lifeline to the Philippines, reminding her of the family she left behind. In the Morning Sun is a gentle portrait of aging, migration, and memory.

metas.name: A Wolf in the Suburbs
metas.description: Welcome to Mississauga where lawns are clipped, neighbors are watchful and no blade of grass dares misbehave. Except at Wolf Ruck’s place. His lawn grows wild, and so does the trouble.

metas.name: Eructation
metas.description: Kaylee is an insanely loud burper. The world record for loudest female burp is currently set at 107.3 decibels, which is louder than a hair dryer, a lawn mower, and a leaf blower. But it's a number that Kaylee routinely beats on her own—her loudest belch to date is 110 decibels as recorded on her decibel reader app. In this documentary short, we follow her as she prepares to go for the record.

metas.name: 96 Pounds of Dynamite
metas.description: Diagnosed at birth with a rare condition that was expected to kill him, Chad "Shorty" McDaniel embraces humor, grit, and a competitive spirit to live the life others said he would never have and shatter assumptions about disability.

metas.name: Summer of '94
metas.description: When the World Cup landed in the U.S. in 1994, it arrived in a country with no league, no culture, and no clue. A ragtag group of players faced an impossible task: don't embarrass their nation in front of the entire world.

metas.name: Drift
metas.description: Isaac “Drift” Wright, a self-taught photographer and Army veteran haunted by trauma, finds healing through breathtaking, illegal climbs of the world’s tallest structures. But his pursuit of art sparks a high-stakes battle with law enforcement in this intimate portrait of risk, resilience, and freedom in modern America.

metas.name: Summer 2000: The X-Cetra Story
metas.description: Four friends reunite when the album they made as pre-teens becomes a cult hit on the internet and scores a record deal twenty years later. Together, they revisit their friendship and early 2000s girlhood.

metas.name: Mallory's Ghost
metas.description: Mallory, tormented by a fear of being insignificant, accompanies her playwright boyfriend Sam to a retreat on the coast of Maine. She learns that he once took his glamorous ex-girlfriend there. She is overcome by an obsessive curiosity.

metas.name: Glacier's Requiem
metas.description: Glacier’s Requiem follows Nigerian-born, Los Angeles-based modular synthesis artist Colloboh during a period of self-imposed isolation on Iceland’s Snæfellsnes Peninsula. There, he transforms near-imperceptible field recordings of a dying glacier and the ocean into evolving sonic compositions. As his work unfolds, a dialogue between ice and sea emerges – reshaping his understanding of consciousness, ecological collapse, and humanity’s place within both.

metas.name: And Her Body Was Never Found
metas.description: A couple treks deep into the wilderness to make a movie about their troubled relationship, but takes the opportunity to kill each other instead.

metas.name: The Last Critic
metas.description: Sixty years & a million records ago, Robert Christgau invented Rock music criticism. Anyone who has ever read or written a Pop music review has been influenced by Christgau, who canonized legends from The Ramones to Public Enemy & infuriated icons from Lou Reed to Billy Joel. Now in his eighties, Bob is still at it—amazingly with the same vigor, wit, concision and craft that has defined his expansive career. But in a world where albums are irrelevant, where print is dead & where algorithms have eclipsed critics we are forced to ask: What happens next—for Bob, but also for all music criticism? Is this the end of something? Is Robert Christgau the last critic?

metas.name: A Stable Marriage
metas.description: A woman's sexual fantasy is fulfilled - with surprising ramifications.

metas.name: The Man with the Big Hat
metas.description: An unsung pioneer of 1970s Texas Progressive Country, Steven Fromholz had a knack for snatching defeat from the jaws of victory. Revered by legends like Willie Nelson, Lyle Lovett & John Denver, he remained commercially unknown. He sought redemption on the Rio Grande as a river guide until a debilitating stroke erased his musical memory, stripping Fromholz of his artistic identity.  With an almost obsessive persistence bolstered by newly discovered archives as well as never-before-heard recordings, this intimate and impressionistic portrayal unveils the evolution of Fromholz, and reshapes the notion of success and artistic fortitude.

metas.name: HORSE
metas.description: Two guys play a game of HORSE

metas.name: Stockholm
metas.description: A young woman’s exploration of BDSM takes a dangerous turn when she’s abducted, forcing her to confront the boundaries between desire, consent and control.

metas.name: HAG
metas.description: Our story begins with our heroine breaking up with her obnoxious boyfriend; what should be a moment of liberation instead transforms her from a regular thirty-something into a hag with snakes for hair. Hag battles society pressures, inner longings, and the tick of her own biological clock. She searches for love and meaning in a hellscape of waning fertility, dating apps and the rotten stench of the patriarchy. In this surreal South London, Hag's journey becomes mythical as her despair crystallises into a quest for answers, and she must face the ultimate test! In a world where being true to yourself makes you monstrous, what is the cost of compromise and repressing your authentic self?

metas.name: Ceremony
metas.description: When the Nuxalk trace the vanished ooligan to a land claim filed the very day smallpox arrived, their radio station becomes courtroom, confessional and conjuring ground; an older law insists: the fish return when the people do.

metas.name: Son of a Bikram
metas.description: Raag, an obsessive hot yoga practitioner faces a crisis when his idol is accused of sexual assault. On the same day, he loses his mother and discovers a family secret that leads him to desperately search for answers.

metas.name: American Muscle
metas.description: A desperate mechanic's plan to escape his past unravels when his sister returns home and two violent debt collectors close in.

metas.name: If Both Could Be
metas.description: Faced with a decision about their future in a non-LGBTQ+ affirming church, a young queer Welsh theologian seeks clarity around their calling to Christian ministry.

metas.name: The Birds Tell Me All There Is To Know
metas.description: Two strangers quietly struggle to navigate their changing identities as the summer draws to a close.

metas.name: Brian
metas.description: An acerbic high school student prone to panic attacks runs for class president to get closer to his teacher.

metas.name: Manhood
metas.description: "Manhood" follows Dallas entrepreneur Bill Moore as he attempts to make penis enlargement as commonplace as Botox. Along the way, an OnlyFans star and a father of five put their bodies—and their insecurities—on the line. Blending dark humor with unexpected empathy, "Manhood" examines shame, addiction, and the fragile myths of American masculinity.

metas.name: Plan C
metas.description: Siblings Clare and Danny find themselves fugitives after a bungled robbery, leading them on a perilous journey filled with high-speed pursuits, moral dilemmas, and shocking revelations in the crime thriller "Plan C."

metas.name: Sender
metas.description: After receiving a series of packages containing unnervingly personal items, a woman tumbles down a paranoid rabbit hole to find her mysterious sender.

metas.name: Mermaid
metas.description: A 10-year-old boy yearning to become a mermaid meets a struggling drag queen consumed by grief. Their unexpected bond grows so strong they'll put everything on the line to preserve it.

metas.name: Their Town
metas.description: When Abby’s boyfriend unexpectedly drops out of the high school play, she is forced to help outlier Matt step into the role opposite her. Over the course of a long night wandering their small town, the two examine their futures and unearth surprises from their past.

metas.name: Born to Lose
metas.description: A young biker grapples with his father's troubled legacy and escalating debts to a local gangster. As he races to restore a vintage motorcycle to save himself, he must confront family secrets and forge his own identity.

metas.name: Chili Finger
metas.description: When a small town lawyer discovers a severed finger in her chili, she blackmails the restaurant for a cash payout in an effort to regain control over her mundane life. The situation quickly spirals out of control, and her life descends into chaos.

metas.name: The Peril at Pincer Point
metas.description: On a quest to prove his competency, an inept sound recordist finds himself entangled in a nautical prophecy on the spectral island of Pincer Point.

metas.name: Stormbound
metas.description: An intimate look at Jeff Gammons, a chronically ill man who finds peace and beauty chasing the world's largest hurricanes.

metas.name: The Pink Pill: Sex, Drugs and Who Has Control
metas.description: A documentary that captures a pivotal moment in the ongoing struggle for complete health care equality, at a time when bodily autonomy hangs in the balance.

metas.name: Criterion
metas.description: After the devil is thrown out of Heaven, he goes into the desert to confront his replacement.

metas.name: My Mother: Artist and Teacher
metas.description: My Mother: Artist and Teacher is for us as a collaboration, as an opportunity to contact our mother heart, our father heart, our own heart. Sing along, hum, vibrate with moans, tears, laughter, or silence! It's free therapy!!!

metas.name: margins of unfinished self
metas.description: ‘margins of unfinished self’ is a work that explores the shifting boundaries of the self. It draws on micro narratives and sonic fragments that move through grief’s reshaping of time and identity – moments where scepticism sits alongside yearning, where the mystical brushes up against the everyday, and where multiplicity begins to feel like a condition of being.

metas.name: In The World You Will Have Tribulation, But Take Heart; I Have Overcome The World (Short)
metas.description: A saint prepares to perform a miracle in celebration of her 33rd birthday.

metas.name: Talking in Your Sleep
metas.description: A conversation between two characters in their sleep.

metas.name: Asia - Live in England
metas.description: Asia are back and roaring in their new, exhilarating line-up! Recorded live on the first of three unforgettable nights at Trading Boundaries in Sussex, in April 2025, this release captures the band performing their iconic 1982 debut album ASIA in full, along with a selection of their greatest hits.  Featuring Geoff Downes (keys), Virgil Donati (drums – ex-Planet X), John Mitchell (guitars – Arena, It Bites etc.) and the astonishing Harry Whitley (on bass and vocals), this fresh incarnation of Asia brings both reverence for the classics and a thrilling new energy to the stage. The setlist includes fan favorites like Heat of the Moment, Only Time Will Tell, Sole Survivor, One Step Closer and Time Again, alongside video-era and bonus tracks such as Ride Easy, Video Killed the Radio Star, The Heat Goes On and Daylight (video exclusive).

metas.name: If We Were Ants
metas.description: A short film about two individuals navigating their own interpretations of love, offering an intimate look at emotions, connection, and perception.

metas.name: Venus of Ossabaw
metas.description: A young woman, newly-escaped from Georgia’s Ossabaw Island, navigates the swamps of Spanish East Florida on the way to a free life in Catholic St. Augustine when she discovers that in order to survive, she must both battle and befriend a volatile landscape.

metas.name: Panic Attack
metas.description: Mia has to retake her work ID photo and is running late but the only thing in her way is herself.

metas.name: Unscripted: The Ghostrunners Documentary
metas.description: The Ghostrunners Podcast, hosted by Brad Ellis and Jake Triplett, consists of lighthearted, relatable, and hilarious banter between two best friends who love to find the humor in everyday life. This documentary tells the story of how two guys randomly starting a podcast unexpectedly led to a passionate fanbase and community surrounding it.

metas.name: Mira Lunet
metas.description: A visual EP. The second volume of Katia Krow's space-inspired serial. "Music for Bleary-Eyed Stars."  About wishes, madness, gravitas, dots, love, ghosts, etc...

metas.name: Long Distance
metas.description: When Ian and Elle start college, they must combat the difficulties that come with a Long Distance relationship.

metas.name: Woman to Woman
metas.description: When long-buried family secrets come to light, two Detroit mothers must confront a shared past to save their daughters from danger.

metas.name: Cry No More
metas.description: Director and actor D.C. Stoy explores the nuanced nature of a character's non-linear timeline, which pits the mundaneness of stability against his internal desire for more out of his life, where risk is the reward.

metas.name: Tattoo Movie
metas.description: A woman receives her first tattoo from a friend.

metas.name: Liminal
metas.description: Liminal is a hazy recollection of a lost girl turning thirty, suspended in the in-between spaces. At its heart, it’s about female friendship: that singular bond that can anchor us through the chaos of identity, time, and transformation. Beneath the film’s dreamlike surface is a quieter question about what keeps us here, what reminds us to hold on. In Liminal, friendship becomes not just a source of beauty, but a lifeline — a reminder that even in the most fragile moments, connection can tether us to life itself.

metas.name: Stuck in the 90s
metas.description: STUCK IN THE 90's is the 5th feature film by M. Woods, the culmination of the Stuck in the 90's video art webisodic which has been released through Full Spectrum Features as part of their acclaimed CYBERSLIME series. Starring "The Prom Date Fuck", this terrible piece of shit is a nightmare of internet sludge, reveling in its own grotesque nihilism, dripping in micro plastics and auto-erotic lust. A nightmare of hyperreal proportions.

metas.name: Traffic Throughout the Days
metas.description: A collection of videos taken of Brooklyn traffic set to ambient music.

metas.name: Let's Murder Like It's 1999!
metas.description: Laney is dreading her high school reunion because of a sad background. However, when classmates begin to die, she must find the perpetrator before she or her daughter become the next victim.

metas.name: All Caked Up
metas.description: Follow the mythic journey of Brick and Cerulio as they try to make the perfect cake.

metas.name: A New Beginning
metas.description: A reserved artist’s carefully crafted life begins to crack when a persistent neighbor grows dangerously curious.

metas.name: Murder Gum And Fly Fishing
metas.description: The re-telling of Edgar Allan Poe's "The Tell-Tale Heart" in which teenage fly fisherman Travis attempts to convince his lawyer that he is not crazy after brutally murdering his fly shop co-worker due to his hauntingly annoying gum chewing.

metas.name: Vindicta
metas.description: In just one moment 19-year-old Hannah's world shatters when her parents are murdered in front of her. After fleeing, she seeks refuge with family friends before becoming the embodiment of rage and revenge towards those responsible for destroying her life. An unexpected connection with a handsome young Nazi Officer generates a moment of respite, but she is consumed by vengeance at any cost, no matter what or when. The story is inspired by the true events of women who helped defeat the Nazis during WWII.

metas.name: War Machine
metas.description: On one last grueling mission during Army Ranger training, a combat engineer must lead his unit in a fight against a giant otherworldly killing machine.

metas.name: Movie Magic
metas.description: Kat, an aspiring writer, and Justin, a fantasizing director, once believed in the magic of movies - until making one of their own stalled their dreams. Now passing the days as ushers in a fading London indie cinema, they cling to the place as it edges toward closure. On the cinema’s final night, a half-serious wish to be part of the movies lands them inside the screen itself. Swept through a series of classic film worlds, they slip into shifting roles as spies, period protagonists, and something far more monstrous, while forces outside the frame race to bring them back. Filmed at London’s Phoenix Cinema, Movie Magic is a playful, self-aware romantic comedy that celebrates cinema as both escape and obsession.

metas.name: Beautiful and Neat Room
metas.description: In order to be able to afford a small Brooklyn apartment, a fiercely artistic woman decides to cohabitate with one seemingly harmless but secretly crazy roommate after the next and finds herself in some bizarre boundary-pushing experiences, forcing her to question her own norms and the human psyche.

metas.name: Out in the Wilderness
metas.description: A group of friends try to set off on a camping trip. After a series of mistakes leaves the group stranded in the woods, they find themselves needing to go to lengths never before imagined in order to get out alive.

metas.name: I Still Exist.
metas.description: A visceral self-portrait crafted from scraps, old commissions, and film tests. Justin Kaminuma explores the paralyzing anxiety of 'what’s next' by grounding himself in the present, creating a raw, experimental proof of existence and a search for something real.

metas.name: Sandiwara
metas.description: In a night market, five characters recount their own unique story and represent a facet of Malaysian culture rarely explored.

metas.name: Pedro Tomás Explains The World
metas.description: On the volcanic island of La Palma lives Pedro Tomás, a man who can only speak in nouns.

metas.name: Traces of Home
metas.description: Delving into the past and not shying away from the dug-up pain, a young filmmaker speaks to her Mexican mother and Palestinian father about their trying journeys into the United States. In a society with rhetoric increasingly vilifying Mexicans and Palestinians, the filmmaker picks up her camera in a bid to address the grief at the center of the generational trauma that has underscored her relationship with her family. A meditation of loss and grief relieved, ultimately, through reconciliation.

metas.name: Love Sick Rebourne
metas.description: Can Samantha Anderson survive the worst night of her life, or will the weapon of mass destruction she was made to be, take over?

metas.name: Running Late
metas.description: A short and sweet film about a couple running late to their wedding. Made with love! For love!

metas.name: Just Friends
metas.description: Natalie connects with Isaac after a series of bad dates, but navigating the blurry lines between friendship and romance proves messier than expected.

metas.name: The Letter
metas.description: A one-minute short where a piece of news changes the relationship between two best friends forever.

metas.name: Sketti.
metas.description: Two friends video chat to talk, but one refuses to turn his camera on...again

metas.name: Treagens' Black Shadows
metas.description: Treagen Kiers' Black Shadows is a chilling triptych thriller that dissects the fragile morality of the modern world through three visceral chapters wrapped into one provocative film.

metas.name: Incessant
metas.description: Haunted by what she believes is her husband's spirit, a grieving widow embarks on a time-traveling journey through her memories in a desperate attempt to change the past.

metas.name: Moana Jr: The Ranches Academy School Performance
metas.description: Live Recording of the Ranches Academy School Performance of "Disney’s Moana JR", a musical adaptation of the 2016 Disney animated film, bringing the adventures of Moana and her village of Motunui to life onstage. Moana JR. features all the beloved songs from the film, written by Tony®, GRAMMY, Emmy, and Pulitzer Prize-winning composer Lin-Manuel Miranda, Opetaia Foa’i, and Mark Mancina, including “How Far I’ll Go,” “Shiny,” and “You’re Welcome.”  This thrilling and heartwarming coming-of-age story follows the strong-willed Moana as she sets sail across the Pacific to save her village and discover the truth about her heritage. Moana and the legendary demigod Maui embark on an epic journey of self-discovery and camaraderie as both learn to harness the power that lies within. With empowering messages of bravery and selflessness, Moana JR. is sure to bring out the hero within each of us.

metas.name: KIRAC 29: Whore Dialectics
metas.description: While Ben Lunato awaits his day in court, we embark with him on a journey through the world of whores. We traverse bizarre mental landscapes and arrive in Los Angeles, where we meet our friend, the art dealer Stefan Simchowitz, and, of course, whores. Endlessly many whores.  In Los Angeles, walking through the warehouses that store Stefan Simchowitz’s vast collection of contemporary African art, a promising discovery emerges concerning whores and fetishized Africans. In this film these figures appear to merge into an affirmative horizon, beyond woke ideology and politics, toward a new art, reaching back to reestablish a link with modernist symbolism as represented by Picasso’s Demoiselles d’Avignon.

metas.name: XOXO
metas.description: Love's mirror

metas.name: Make Up Sex
metas.description: After a year of dating, a young couple explores the boundaries of what Make Up Sex can do for their relationship. Jeremy, not looking for confrontation, agrees to give it a try as they gear up to start that one fight worth making up over.

metas.name: Season's Greetings
metas.description: At a Christmas party, a girl seeks closure from her ex, only to get answers she doesn’t want.

metas.name: Bi-Rista
metas.description: Leslie, an awkward queer woman, tries to work up the courage to ask out the cute barista at her local coffee shop.

metas.name: I Just Shit My Pants
metas.description: On Valentine's Day, a man shits his pants while proposing to his girlfriend.

metas.name: Tender: Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips
metas.description: "Tender" is a tribute to the care, responsibility, and quiet eccentricity of the goaltending position – exploring a lesser-seen side of some of the fiercest competitors in a brutal sport. Told through the intertwined careers of Team USA goaltenders Aerin Frankel & Gwyneth Philips, this short documentary highlights the talents, habits, and quirks that make both athletes individually elite at their craft, while allowing their distinct personalities to shine through. It also examines the unique bond between goalie partners – a relationship defined by mutual trust and respect, forged over years as both teammates and opponents.

metas.name: Pencil & Doodles
metas.description: On the eve of her departure, a citywide blackout traps two childhood best friends in an apartment, forcing them to face the conversation about love they can no longer avoid.

metas.name: My Hero
metas.description: On their way to Comic-Con, a timid guy in an ill-fitting Spider-Man freezes as two bullies humiliate his girlfriend.

metas.name: The Amazing Bulk: Re-Bulked
metas.description: The greatest mockbuster of all time has been reimagined and reinterpreted by nearly 100 people.

metas.name: Homewreckers
metas.description: With his friends constantly crashing at his house and straining his relationship with his girlfriend, James must choose between his friends and his girlfriend.

metas.name: Sam Darnold's Redemption
metas.description: Sam Darnold's journey from early career setbacks to Super Bowl stardom with the Seattle Seahawks is chronicled. NFL Films follows the player's path through multiple teams, showcasing both struggles and triumphs.

metas.name: For The Love of Film
metas.description: A heartbroken film student is pulled out of his slump by his colleague and rediscovers passion for cinema. When a major movie podcast invites him to join an episode, he sees a chance to finally move forward as he steps into a moment that could change everything.

metas.name: D RATING
metas.description: After anonymously purchasing a service from his favorite OnlyFans model, a young man must confront his choices when meeting this woman in the real world.

metas.name: Window Service Only
metas.description: A new customer can’t decide if he wants the single or the double.

metas.name: Two Guys and a Time Machine
metas.description: Two roommates find out how to control time what could go wrong? (answer: everything)

metas.name: Ghosted In Love
metas.description: At a Halloween party, a reclusive English major, Will, falls in love with the mysterious Ghost Girl. But before he can get her name, she vanishes. It is up to Will and his best friend Marty to find Ghost Girl before she is lost forever.

metas.name: Cupid
metas.description: Follow Cupid and her new client Neha as they race the clock to find her a date for Valentine's Day. Will she find a perfect match? Or has it been there all along...?

metas.name: The Prodigy
metas.description: Roger Sportsmans comes to Bellingham to escape his crime-riddled past when he stumbles on an underground foosball ring.

metas.name: How to Kill a Mermaid: The Linnea Mills Story
metas.description: A heart-wrenching true-crime documentary exploring the death of 18-year-old Linnea Mills during a 2020 cold-water scuba dive in Montana’s Glacier National Park. Using never-before-seen footage, it reexamines the fatal dive and investigation, offering an intimate portrait of a life cut short.

metas.name: Wild Asia: Life at Extremes
metas.description: Atop the world’s tallest peaks of the Himalayas, get an intimate look at elusive Snow Leopards and Tiger moms in Nepal raising their young. Witness a Tibetan Fox ‘hide-and-seek hunting’ amongst yaks on an ancient plateau, catch glimpses of the secretive red panda in its remote forest stronghold, meet the remarkable long-eared jumping Jerboa in the harsh Gobi Desert, and fly alongside beautiful songbirds feeding on “sapcicles” in northern Japan. In the world’s richest coral seas of the Pacific, discover the cute-yet-deadly Sea Bunny and be immersed in an unbelievable shark feeding frenzy, that’s never been filmed before. Each story reveals the incredible ways in which wildlife has adapted to thrive in these challenging habitats.

metas.name: On Air
metas.description: A driven high school announcer’s carefully controlled routine is thrown off balance when a carefree co-host enters her world, forcing her to confront perfection, vulnerability, and what it means to share her voice both on air and off.

metas.name: The Butterfly Lab
metas.description: At Oregon’s only women’s prison, incarcerated women raise an endangered butterfly. In the Lab, eggs are collected and caterpillars are fed by hand, each life stage carefully nurtured.  As metamorphosis nears, the film reflects on captivity, purpose, care, and the natural world.

metas.name: Love Hurts
metas.description: After kidnapping a Valentine’s Day icon, local mob boss Frank Deeno learns the hard way that love hurts like hell.

metas.name: Love Notes
metas.description: A couple diagnoses and dissects their relationship through thoughts and notes.

metas.name: AEW Grand Slam Australia 2026
metas.description: Grand Slam Australia 2026 was a professional wrestling event promoted by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on February 14, 2026 at Qudos Bank Arena in Sydney, New South Wales, Australia, and was headlined by MJF (c) vs. Brody King for the AEW World Championship.

metas.name: Creation Story: A First Date
metas.description: A middle-aged woman embarks on a first date.

metas.name: Osculum Infame: The Shameful Kiss
metas.description: A Catholic college student wants to join a coven, so she goes to a chapel and performs a ritual in hopes of summoning the devil. Where she can then perform the Osculum Infame and be initiated!

metas.name: The Last Egg
metas.description: After the passing of her last living relative, an astronaut travels across a sterile universe to a hostile planet believed to have a psionic egg with the ability to restore life. However, the closer she gets the more aggressive the egg and the planet become.

metas.name: Kiss Me
metas.description: Desperate for affection, Hazel unravels while grappling with the lack of intimacy and fulfillment in her life.

metas.name: The Dating App Killer: The Monica White Story
metas.description: A divorcee reenters the dating pool by creating an online profile, but when her match displays unsettling behavior and a series of women from the same dating site go missing, she must save herself from becoming the next victim.

metas.name: The Same Frame
metas.description: While writing a screenplay for successful film producer Sally Kimmer, twin brothers Austin and Lee learn of their true sibling rivalry. As tensions rise, Sally finds herself having to prove herself worthy to her pushy boss Mr. Williams.

metas.name: Because of Cupid
metas.description: Best friends Naomi and Marcus participate in a Valentine's Day mocktail competition but things go awry when Cupid interferes with a love potion that affects Marcus and several of their friends.

metas.name: Just Shy of Love
metas.description: A story of boy meets girl.

metas.name: Cigar Box
metas.description: A high schooler gives his girlfriend a cigar box, but she rejects it. Throughout the years, as their paths cross, he takes each opportunity to ask her why.

metas.name: Back Then
metas.description: Haneul greets his parents and heads to college. While in a taxi to New York, a diminishing past memory is brought up — through one old, crumbled Leche Frita wrapper.

metas.name: Ernie and Emma
metas.description: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

metas.name: More Than Monogamy
metas.description: Sexuality is complex. Sexuality is diverse. Sexuality is More Than Monogamy.  "The Lifestyle" is a massive umbrella term that encompasses swinging, polyamory, kink...and so much more; this documentary is all about highlighting and explaining why it might be perfect for your relationship and maybe why it won't.  Designed to be both educational and entertaining, let's look at why there can be so much more to a relationship than monogamy.

metas.name: Red Flags
metas.description: After hundreds of bad dates, a chance meeting brings two people, in the same boat, together.

metas.name: Because of You
metas.description: Brayden, a young 17 year old boy, faces conflict and self doubt as he navigates the complexities of one's first love. Supported by many, he remains in question and fear until crossing paths with the one who changes everything - Thomas.

metas.name: Spooder-Kid Shattered World
metas.description: Full movie version of series.  Its been a few months since Spooder-Kid has defeated the Bubbler. Its winter time. The boys are well adjusted to their new lives. But when a new villain who goes by the name of Octavius creates a dangerous machine to  make infinite energy and finish what the Bubbler started , Spooder-Kid intervenes. Will he save his town from this new unwanted threat?

metas.name: Gangster’s Daughter 4
metas.description: Kadisha Spencer continues to run her father’s brutal empire while matching wits with Detective Steel and meticulously eliminating her enemies.

metas.name: Working in Progress
metas.description: Working in Progress is a quirky, offbeat mockumentary that hilariously captures the bizarre and absurd day-to-day operations of Scorbsackeg, a company with a purpose no one can quite figure out. Founded and run by the delusional and self-obsessed CEO James Brownlee, the company operates out of his sister Janet's home in the small town of Progress, Delaware. Despite its lack of clear direction, James believes the business is destined for greatness. He's so convinced, in fact, that he hires a film crew to capture his "rise to success," planning to sell the documentary alongside his autobiography when he makes it big.

metas.name: Living in the Cemetery
metas.description: A mother haunted by trauma becomes overprotective of her daughter, but when the daughter falls in love, their bond fractures. As buried secrets emerge, both must confront whether forgiveness can heal old wounds before it's too late.

metas.name: Georgia Peach
metas.description: A nurse in recovery from alcoholism must confront her past and her brother's growing demands, risking everything she's worked for to reclaim her life or lose it all to her inner demons.

metas.name: Body Of Nurses
metas.description: A doctor is led into a web of betrayal by his nurses on a fateful night shift at a mysterious hospital.

metas.name: Evaporation
metas.description: Two strangers bond through fleeting moments of smoking, but beneath their connection lie a gut wrenching emptiness they can't escape.

metas.name: Big Scouse
metas.description: Big Scouse follows Terry O’Neill’s journey from Merseyside to Richmond, Virginia and the impact he had on the city's football culture with his legendary pub Penny Lane and what makes it the best football bar in America.

metas.name: Feigning Tennis
metas.description: An amateur tennis player must keep up the facade of being a pro to delay her wedding to a man she’s fallen out of love with. If her career takes off, she can excuse herself from the relationship with the promise of bigger and better things, even though it might reveal she was leading him on, but if she fails, she’d rather be in a one-sided marriage than completely alone. How far will she feign tennis success before the truth comes out?

metas.name: Caught Slippin
metas.description: Three couples-Shawn and Chelsea, Mack and Ciara, and Jen and Mike-go on a weekend getaway to Joshua Tree. The trip takes a dark turn when Mack goes missing after the first day. As tensions rise and secrets come to light, the friends must confront their deepest fears and suspicions, unraveling a mystery that threatens to change their lives forever.

metas.name: Keep It Going
metas.description: This film, which follows Xavier on his first-ever headlining tour, captures a young rapper at an inflection point in his career: he's the biggest he's ever been and needs to make a decision of where to go next. With a dedicated fanbase keeping up with his every move, Xavier is still working to make his most basic ends meet. "I'm homeless right now. We trying to get a crib right now," he admits at one point during our doc. "We still got a long way to go."

metas.name: HORSEBOTTOM
metas.description: Langely Horsebottom is an aspiring basketball player and showcases his talents on film.

metas.name: Who Killed These Women? (The Tinley Park 5)
metas.description: An examination into the largest unsolved mass shooting in modern day America today. On Feb 2, 2008 a killer executed 5 women inside a Lane Bryant department store in suburban Chicago.

metas.name: Confessions of a Girl
metas.description: She has something to say.....and you better listen.

metas.name: Violent Bastards
metas.description: A disillusioned teenager embraces violence as a means to truly fight for ideologies, drawing his estranged brother into a bloody confrontation that will leave both scarred.

metas.name: Soberman
metas.description: After waking up from his first hangover, Waylon Stone experiences a life‑changing cinematic event that makes him rethink his weekend drinking habits.

metas.name: Starry Eyed
metas.description: 'A struggling actor and burnt-out painter find themselves torn between passion, love, and day jobs over a magical night at the movies.'

metas.name: The Wrong Baby Daddy
metas.description: Lila’s life finally feels complete when she starts a dream job with her close friend Robin, falls into a promising romance with Mark, and discovers she’s pregnant. But everything shifts when Julia, Mark’s ex-wife, reappears the moment she learns about the baby. At first, Julia’s involvement seems harmless, even polite, until she begins showing up uninvited, inserting herself into every corner of Lila’s new life. As Julia’s presence grows more intrusive and her intentions more unsettling, Lila realizes she may be fighting to protect far more than just her future. Soon, what began as a perfect new chapter becomes a tense battle of boundaries, obsession, and survival.

metas.name: The Blind Date
metas.description: When a young woman is set up on a blind date in New York City, she realizes quickly her date is her ex-girlfriend and must decide whether to stay or go.

metas.name: For the Love of Strippers
metas.description: An intimate portrait of two L.A. strippers and activists fighting to protect their art, safety, and livelihoods during a critical inflection point for the industry and their own lives.

metas.name: BYU's Resident Cougar
metas.description: A documentary crew follows Ella Gible, a BYU student for 20 years, who refuses to graduate until she finds a husband.

metas.name: Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel
metas.description: Filmed in the intimate and historic setting of London’s Union Chapel, Josh Groban: An Intimate Evening at The Union Chapel captures the acclaimed vocalist at his most personal and powerful. Shot in November 2025, the concert film showcases Groban performing many of his most beloved songs alongside new material, all reimagined within the chapel’s soaring acoustics. The film highlights Groban’s extraordinary voice, emotional range, and deep connection with his audience.

metas.name: Bikini Nurses
metas.description: With the sheriff set to padlock their clinic at dawn, and a wealthy buyer on the prowl, three Bikini Nurses mount one last move: to impress their wealthiest patron with a show so that he'll buy the clinic and save the day.

metas.name: TNA No Surrender 2026
metas.description: No Surrender 2026 was a professional wrestling event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) that took place on February 13, 2026 at The Pinnacle in Nashville, Tennessee, USA, and was headlined by Eddie Edwards & Nic Nemeth vs. Leon Slater & Mike Santana in a Tag Team Match.

metas.name: My Dog: The Paradox
metas.description: This film is a celebration of the absurd, unconditional love between humans and their pets, equal parts hilarious and heartfelt.

metas.name: Kissing Is the Easy Part
metas.description: Sean's gunning for MIT. Flora's ditching the SAT. A secret deal with her tenured parents sparks a romance that challenges everything they believe in.

metas.name: Mostly Void, Partially Stars
metas.description: When Sammie Mckenzie's low-stakes boyfriend cheats on her with the girlfriend of Drew Stark - Sammies high school ex - Drew and Sammies lives collide together in one night that will re-contextualize their pasts, presents, and futures.

metas.name: The Story of Ruby Falls
metas.description: A 5-minute short film that depicts not only the fated discovery of Ruby Falls in 1928, but also the passions of adoration and devotion that drove explorer Leo Lambert onward. Only viewable at Ruby Falls in Chattanooga, Tennessee.

metas.name: Joe's College Road Trip
metas.description: To teach his sheltered grandson about the real world, Madea's foul-mouthed brother Joe takes the college-bound teen on a raucous cross-country road trip.

metas.name: The Stranger in the Snow
metas.description: A careless young woman visits her date's apartment where they hear a strange repeated knocking throughout the evening.
